        localStorage.removeItem('KRONO_OTA_CUSTOM_HTML');
        localStorage.removeItem('KRONO_OTA_VERSION_TAG');
        localStorage.removeItem('KRONO_OTA_LIVE_CSS');
        localStorage.removeItem('KRONO_OTA_LIVE_JS');
        return;
      }
      try {
        let customHtml = localStorage.getItem('KRONO_OTA_CUSTOM_HTML');
        if (customHtml && !window.__KRONO_RUNNING_OTA__) {
          const trimmed = customHtml.trim();
          if (trimmed.startsWith('{')) {
            try {
              const parsed = JSON.parse(trimmed);
              if (parsed && parsed.html) {
                customHtml = parsed.html;
                localStorage.setItem('KRONO_OTA_CUSTOM_HTML', customHtml);
                if (parsed.version) localStorage.setItem('KRONO_OTA_VERSION_TAG', String(parsed.version).replace(/^v/i, ''));
              }
            } catch (err) {}
          }
          if (customHtml.includes('<!DOCTYPE html>') || customHtml.includes('<html')) {
            window.__KRONO_RUNNING_OTA__ = true;
            window.__KRONO_OTA_BOOTED__ = true;
            document.open();
            document.write(customHtml);
            document.close();
            return;
          }
        }
      } catch (e) { console.error('OTA Bootloader fallback:', e); }
    })();

  <style id="krono-core-fx-css">
/* === KRONO FINANZAS v6.5.76 CRISP-TEXT VISUAL & MOTION ENGINE === */
html, body {
  -webkit-font-smoothing: auto !important;
  text-rendering: optimizeLegibility;
  height: 100dvh !important;
  max-height: 100dvh !important;
  overflow: hidden !important;
  overscroll-behavior: none !important;
}

/* Text-containing animations use relative top/margin-top (no transform/scale) so Chromium preserves razor-sharp ClearType text on every frame */
@keyframes kronoTabIn {
  0% { opacity: 0; top: 16px; }
  100% { opacity: 1; top: 0; }
}
@keyframes kronoModalIn {
  0% { opacity: 0; top: 18px; }
  100% { opacity: 1; top: 0; }
}
@keyframes kronoBackdropIn {
  0% { opacity: 0; }
  100% { opacity: 1; }
}
@keyframes kronoDropIn {
  0% { opacity: 0; margin-top: -6px; }
  100% { opacity: 1; margin-top: 0; }
}
@keyframes kronoDropInUp {
  0% { opacity: 0; margin-top: 6px; }
  100% { opacity: 1; margin-top: 0; }
}
@keyframes kronoBurstIn {
  0% { opacity: 0; top: 14px; }
  14% { opacity: 1; top: 0px; }
  84% { opacity: 1; top: -18px; }
  100% { opacity: 0; top: -34px; }
}
@keyframes kronoRipple {
  0% { opacity: 0.46; transform: translate(-50%, -50%) scale(0); }
  100% { opacity: 0; transform: translate(-50%, -50%) scale(2.5); }
}
@keyframes kronoBarShine {
  0% { transform: translateX(-120%); }
  100% { transform: translateX(260%); }
}
@keyframes kronoDotPulse {
  0%, 100% { box-shadow: 0 0 0 0 rgba(52, 211, 153, 0.65); }
  60% { box-shadow: 0 0 0 8px rgba(52, 211, 153, 0); }
}
@keyframes kronoFabRing {
  0%, 100% { opacity: 0.45; transform: scale(1); }
  50% { opacity: 0; transform: scale(1.36); }
}

.krono-sync-dot {
  animation: kronoDotPulse 2.4s ease-out infinite;
}

/* === AMBIENT CURSOR SPOTLIGHT (Pure light layer, GPU smooth) === */
#krono-cursor-spotlight {
  position: fixed;
  left: 0;
  top: 0;
  width: 580px;
  height: 580px;
  border-radius: 9999px;
  pointer-events: none;
  z-index: 1;
  opacity: 0;
  transform: translate3d(-9999px, -9999px, 0);
  background: radial-gradient(circle, rgba(34, 211, 238, 0.17) 0%, rgba(139, 92, 246, 0.095) 40%, rgba(16, 185, 129, 0.035) 62%, transparent 74%);
  filter: blur(30px);
  transition: opacity 0.35s ease;
  will-change: transform;
}

/* === LIVING FROSTED GLASS CARDS (.glass-97) — No mask-composite offscreen blur === */
.glass-97 {
  position: relative;
  top: 0;
  left: 0;
  backdrop-filter: blur(22px) saturate(195%) !important;
  -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(22px) saturate(195%) !important;
  background: linear-gradient(155deg, rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.048) 0%, rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.28) 100%) !important;
  border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.17) !important;
  box-shadow: 0 18px 42px -12px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.52), 0 1px 0 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.24) inset, 0 -1px 0 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.06) inset !important;
  transition: top 0.36s cubic-bezier(0.22, 1.45, 0.36, 1), left 0.32s cubic-bezier(0.22, 1.45, 0.36, 1), box-shadow 0.28s ease, border-color 0.22s ease, background-color 0.22s ease !important;
}
.glass-97::before {
  content: "";
  position: absolute;
  inset: 0;
  border-radius: inherit;
  pointer-events: none;
  opacity: 0;
  transition: opacity 0.26s ease;
  background: radial-gradient(400px circle at var(--mx, 50%) var(--my, 50%), rgba(34, 211, 238, 0.16), rgba(139, 92, 246, 0.08) 45%, transparent 72%);
  z-index: 0;
}
.glass-97:hover::before {
  opacity: 1;
}
.glass-97 > *:not(.krono-ripple) {
  position: relative;
  z-index: 1;
}
main .glass-97:hover {
  border-color: rgba(103, 232, 249, 0.44) !important;
  box-shadow: 0 16px 32px -12px rgba(6, 182, 212, 0.28), 0 0 0 1px rgba(103, 232, 249, 0.16) inset, 0 1px 0 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.36) inset !important;
}

/* === HERO CONSOLIDATED NET WORTH CARD === */
.krono-hero-card {
  background: linear-gradient(128deg, rgba(34, 211, 238, 0.09) 0%, rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.36) 48%, rgba(139, 92, 246, 0.10) 100%) !important;
}

/* === SPRING CARDS (.spring-card) — Crisp relative top lift === */
.spring-card {
  position: relative !important;
  top: 0 !important;
  left: 0 !important;
  transform: none !important;
  overflow: hidden !important;
  filter: none !important;
  cursor: pointer !important;
  transition: top 0.36s cubic-bezier(0.22, 1.48, 0.36, 1), box-shadow 0.3s ease, border-color 0.22s ease, background-color 0.22s ease !important;
}
.spring-card:hover {
  top: -6px !important;
  transform: none !important;
  background-color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.065) !important;
  border-color: rgba(34, 211, 238, 0.58) !important;
  box-shadow: 0 18px 34px -12px rgba(6, 182, 212, 0.38), 0 0 20px -8px rgba(139, 92, 246, 0.24), 0 1px 0 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.42) inset !important;
}
.spring-card:active {
  top: -1px !important;
  transform: none !important;
  border-color: rgba(103, 232, 249, 0.88) !important;
  box-shadow: 0 10px 26px -8px rgba(6, 182, 212, 0.34), 0 1px 0 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.32) inset !important;
}
.spring-card .rounded-full.mono {
  position: relative;
  top: 0;
  transition: top 0.28s cubic-bezier(0.22, 1.45, 0.36, 1), background-color 0.22s ease, border-color 0.22s ease, box-shadow 0.22s ease;
}
.spring-card:hover .rounded-full.mono {
  top: -1px;
  background-color: rgba(34, 211, 238, 0.28);
  border-color: rgba(103, 232, 249, 0.72);
  box-shadow: 0 0 20px rgba(34, 211, 238, 0.42);
}

/* === SPRING BUTTONS (.spring-btn) — Crisp relative top lift === */
.spring-btn {
  position: relative !important;
  top: 0 !important;
  left: 0 !important;
  transform: none !important;
  overflow: hidden !important;
  filter: none !important;
  transition: top 0.3s cubic-bezier(0.22, 1.52, 0.36, 1), box-shadow 0.24s ease, background-color 0.2s ease, border-color 0.2s ease, color 0.2s ease !important;
}
.spring-btn:hover {
  top: -3px !important;
  transform: none !important;
  box-shadow: 0 7px 16px -5px rgba(6, 182, 212, 0.42), 0 0 12px -4px rgba(34, 211, 238, 0.20), 0 0 0 1px rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.24) inset !important;
}
.spring-btn:active {
  top: 1px !important;
  transform: none !important;
  box-shadow: 0 4px 12px -2px rgba(6, 182, 212, 0.32) !important;
}

/* === SEMANTIC KPI TILES IN PENDIENTES WIDGET === */
.krono-kpi-tile {
  position: relative !important;
  top: 0 !important;
  transform: none !important;
  transition: top 0.32s cubic-bezier(0.22, 1.5, 0.36, 1), box-shadow 0.26s ease, border-color 0.22s ease, background-color 0.22s ease !important;
}
.krono-kpi-tile:hover {
  top: -3px !important;
}
.krono-kpi-tile:active {
  top: 0px !important;
}
.krono-kpi-tile .krono-kpi-arrow {
  display: inline-block;
  transition: transform 0.28s cubic-bezier(0.34, 1.7, 0.64, 1), opacity 0.2s ease;
}
.krono-kpi-tile:hover .krono-kpi-arrow {
  transform: translate(2px, -2px) scale(1.2);
}
.krono-kpi-emerald:hover {
  border-color: rgba(52, 211, 153, 0.55) !important;
  background-color: rgba(16, 185, 129, 0.10) !important;
  box-shadow: 0 10px 20px -6px rgba(16, 185, 129, 0.34), 0 1px 0 0 rgba(167, 243, 208, 0.22) inset !important;
}
.krono-kpi-rose:hover {
  border-color: rgba(251, 113, 133, 0.55) !important;
  background-color: rgba(244, 63, 94, 0.10) !important;
  box-shadow: 0 10px 20px -6px rgba(244, 63, 94, 0.34), 0 1px 0 0 rgba(254, 205, 211, 0.22) inset !important;
}
.krono-kpi-amber:hover {
  border-color: rgba(251, 191, 36, 0.55) !important;
  background-color: rgba(245, 158, 11, 0.10) !important;
  box-shadow: 0 10px 20px -6px rgba(245, 158, 11, 0.32), 0 1px 0 0 rgba(253, 230, 138, 0.22) inset !important;
}

/* === QUICK ACTION CARDS (MOVIMIENTO & TRANSFERIR) === */
.krono-quick-btn:hover {
  top: -4px !important;
  transform: none !important;
  border-color: rgba(103, 232, 249, 0.58) !important;
}
.krono-quick-btn:active {
  top: 0px !important;
  transform: none !important;
}
.krono-quick-badge {
  transition: transform 0.36s cubic-bezier(0.34, 1.7, 0.64, 1), background-color 0.24s ease, border-color 0.24s ease, box-shadow 0.24s ease !important;
}
.krono-quick-add:hover .krono-quick-badge {
  transform: scale(1.14) rotate(90deg) !important;
  background-color: rgba(139, 92, 246, 0.28) !important;
  border-color: rgba(196, 181, 253, 0.68) !important;
  box-shadow: 0 0 18px rgba(139, 92, 246, 0.45);
}
.krono-quick-transfer:hover .krono-quick-badge {
  transform: scale(1.14) rotate(-180deg) !important;
  background-color: rgba(34, 211, 238, 0.28) !important;
  border-color: rgba(103, 232, 249, 0.68) !important;
  box-shadow: 0 0 18px rgba(34, 211, 238, 0.45);
}
.krono-quick-chevron {
  position: relative;
  left: 0;
  transition: left 0.28s cubic-bezier(0.22, 1.5, 0.36, 1), color 0.2s ease;
}
.krono-quick-btn:hover .krono-quick-chevron {
  left: 4px;
  color: #67e8f9;
}

/* === ICON MICRO-ANIMATIONS (Icons only — text stays razor sharp!) === */
.spring-btn > span.text-xl:not(.krono-ripple),
.spring-card span.text-2xl:not(.krono-ripple),
.spring-card span.text-xl:not(.krono-ripple),
nav.md\:hidden button > span:first-child:not(.krono-ripple) {
  display: inline-block;
  transition: transform 0.34s cubic-bezier(0.34, 1.7, 0.64, 1) !important;
}
.spring-btn:hover > span.text-xl:not(.krono-ripple),
.spring-card:hover span.text-2xl:not(.krono-ripple),
.spring-card:hover span.text-xl:not(.krono-ripple) {
  transform: scale(1.22) rotate(-7deg) !important;
}

.krono-spin-icon,
.krono-rocket-icon {
  display: inline-block;
  transition: transform 0.42s cubic-bezier(0.34, 1.6, 0.64, 1) !important;
}
.krono-btn-sync:hover .krono-spin-icon {
  transform: rotate(180deg) scale(1.15) !important;
}
.krono-btn-ota:hover .krono-rocket-icon {
  transform: translate(2px, -2px) scale(1.18) rotate(-8deg) !important;
}

/* === SIDEBAR SHELL, BRAND, NAVIGATION & SYNC === */
.krono-sidebar-shell {
  background: linear-gradient(175deg, rgba(10, 18, 36, 0.78) 0%, rgba(7, 13, 28, 0.66) 55%, rgba(14, 18, 38, 0.74) 100%) !important;
  border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.16) !important;
  box-shadow: 0 26px 52px -14px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.64), 0 1px 0 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.24) inset !important;
}
.krono-brand-card {
  position: relative;
  top: 0;
  background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(34, 211, 238, 0.11), rgba(139, 92, 246, 0.09)) !important;
  border: 1px solid rgba(103, 232, 249, 0.24) !important;
  box-shadow: 0 10px 24px -8px rgba(6, 182, 212, 0.26), 0 1px 0 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.18) inset;
  transition: border-color 0.25s ease, box-shadow 0.28s ease;
}
.krono-brand-card:hover {
  border-color: rgba(103, 232, 249, 0.48) !important;
  box-shadow: 0 14px 28px -8px rgba(6, 182, 212, 0.36), 0 1px 0 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.26) inset;
}
.krono-brand-emblem {
  position: relative;
  top: 0;
  background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(34, 211, 238, 0.28), rgba(139, 92, 246, 0.30));
  border: 1px solid rgba(103, 232, 249, 0.50);
  box-shadow: 0 0 20px -4px rgba(34, 211, 238, 0.55), 0 1px 0 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.34) inset;
  transition: top 0.3s cubic-bezier(0.22, 1.5, 0.36, 1), box-shadow 0.28s ease, border-color 0.24s ease;
}
.krono-brand-card:hover .krono-brand-emblem {
  top: -2px;
  border-color: rgba(165, 243, 252, 0.8);
  box-shadow: 0 0 26px -2px rgba(34, 211, 238, 0.72), 0 1px 0 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.45) inset;
}

aside nav {
  overflow: visible !important;
  padding: 2px 8px 2px 2px;
  margin: -2px -8px -2px -2px;
}
aside nav button.krono-nav-item {
  position: relative !important;
  top: 0 !important;
  left: 0 !important;
  transform: none !important;
  overflow: hidden !important;
  flex-shrink: 0 !important;
  min-height: 44px !important;
  border: 1px solid transparent;
  transition: left 0.3s cubic-bezier(0.22, 1.48, 0.36, 1), background-color 0.22s ease, border-color 0.22s ease, color 0.22s ease, box-shadow 0.26s ease !important;
}
aside nav button.krono-nav-item:hover {
  left: 6px !important;
  transform: none !important;
  background-color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.07) !important;
  border-color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.18) !important;
  box-shadow: 0 10px 24px -8px rgba(6, 182, 212, 0.36);
}
aside nav button.krono-nav-item:active {
  left: 3px !important;
  transform: none !important;
}
aside nav button.krono-nav-item .krono-nav-icon {
  transition: transform 0.32s cubic-bezier(0.34, 1.75, 0.64, 1), background-color 0.22s ease, border-color 0.22s ease, box-shadow 0.22s ease !important;
}
aside nav button.krono-nav-item:hover .krono-nav-icon {
  transform: scale(1.14) rotate(-7deg) !important;
  border-color: rgba(103, 232, 249, 0.48) !important;
  background-color: rgba(34, 211, 238, 0.16) !important;
  box-shadow: 0 0 10px -2px rgba(34, 211, 238, 0.42);
}

aside nav button.bg-cyan-400,
nav.md\:hidden button.bg-cyan-400 {
  background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(34, 211, 238, 0.22), rgba(139, 92, 246, 0.14)) !important;
  color: #ecfeff !important;
  border: 1px solid rgba(103, 232, 249, 0.56) !important;
  backdrop-filter: blur(18px) saturate(200%) !important;
  -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(18px) saturate(200%) !important;
  box-shadow: 0 12px 28px -8px rgba(6, 182, 212, 0.46), 0 1px 0 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.34) inset, 0 -1px 0 0 rgba(34, 211, 238, 0.18) inset !important;
}
aside nav button.bg-cyan-400:hover {
  background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(34, 211, 238, 0.30), rgba(139, 92, 246, 0.20)) !important;
  border-color: rgba(103, 232, 249, 0.78) !important;
  box-shadow: 0 16px 34px -8px rgba(6, 182, 212, 0.58), 0 1px 0 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.44) inset !important;
}
aside nav button.bg-cyan-400::after {
  content: "";
  position: absolute;
  left: 5px;
  top: 22%;
  height: 56%;
  width: 3px;
  border-radius: 9999px;
  background: linear-gradient(180deg, #a5f3fc, #22d3ee, #818cf8);
  box-shadow: 0 0 14px rgba(34, 211, 238, 0.95);
}

.krono-sync-box {
  position: relative;
  top: 0;
  transition: top 0.26s cubic-bezier(0.22, 1.45, 0.36, 1), border-color 0.22s ease, background-color 0.22s ease, box-shadow 0.24s ease;
}
.krono-sync-box:hover {
  top: -2px;
  border-color: rgba(103, 232, 249, 0.42);
  background-color: rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.72);
  box-shadow: 0 10px 22px -8px rgba(6, 182, 212, 0.3);
}
.krono-sync-box:active {
  top: 0px;
}
.krono-sync-box .krono-copy-hint {
  display: inline-block;
  transition: transform 0.26s cubic-bezier(0.34, 1.7, 0.64, 1), color 0.2s ease;
}
.krono-sync-box:hover .krono-copy-hint {
  transform: scale(1.2) rotate(-6deg);
  color: #67e8f9;
}

aside .grid-cols-2 > button.spring-btn {
  height: 36px !important;
  min-height: 36px !important;
  max-height: 36px !important;
  align-self: center !important;
}

/* === MOBILE BOTTOM NAV === */
nav.md\:hidden button {
  position: relative;
  top: 0;
  transform: none !important;

    function getEntityActivityTime(item) {
      if (!item || typeof item !== 'object') return 0;
      return Math.max(
        Number(item.updatedAt) || 0,
        Number(item.settledAt) || 0,
        Number(item.lastPaidAt) || 0,
        Number(item.timestamp) || 0,
        Number(item.createdAt) || 0
      );
    }

    function mergeCollectionById(localArr, remoteArr, deletedMap, remoteIsPrimary = true, sortDescByTime = false) {
      const lList = Array.isArray(localArr) ? localArr : [];
      const rList = Array.isArray(remoteArr) ? remoteArr : [];
      const primary = remoteIsPrimary ? rList : lList;
      const secondary = remoteIsPrimary ? lList : rList;
      const map = new Map();

      const tryInsert = (item, fromPrimary) => {
        if (!item || !item.id) return;
        const idKey = String(item.id);
        const delTs = Number(deletedMap && deletedMap[idKey]) || 0;
        const itemTs = getEntityActivityTime(item);
        if (delTs > 0 && delTs >= itemTs) return;
        if (!map.has(idKey)) {
          map.set(idKey, item);
        } else if (!fromPrimary) {
          const existing = map.get(idKey);
          const exTs = getEntityActivityTime(existing);
          if (itemTs > exTs) {
            map.set(idKey, item);
          } else if (Array.isArray(item.paidMonths) || Array.isArray(existing.paidMonths)) {
            existing.paidMonths = Array.from(new Set([...(existing.paidMonths || []), ...(item.paidMonths || [])]));
          }
        }
      };

      primary.forEach(it => tryInsert(it, true));
      secondary.forEach(it => tryInsert(it, false));
      const out = Array.from(map.values());
      if (sortDescByTime) {
        out.sort((a, b) => (Number(b.timestamp || b.createdAt || 0)) - (Number(a.timestamp || a.createdAt || 0)));
      }
      return out;
    }

    function mergeCloudState(localSt, remoteSt) {
      const rTime = Number(remoteSt && remoteSt.updatedAt) || 0;
      const lTime = Number(localSt && localSt.updatedAt) || 0;
      const lastSynced = Number(localStorage.getItem('KRONO_LAST_SYNCED_AT') || 0);
      const localHasConcurrentEdits = lTime > 0 && lastSynced > 0 && lTime > lastSynced;
      const remoteHasConcurrentEdits = rTime > 0 && lastSynced > 0 && rTime > lastSynced;
      const remoteIsPrimary = rTime >= lTime;

      const deletedMap = mergeDeletedIdMaps(localSt.deletedIds, remoteSt.deletedIds);
      const mergedTx = mergeCollectionById(localSt.transactions, remoteSt.transactions, deletedMap, remoteIsPrimary, true);
      const mergedDebts = mergeCollectionById(localSt.debts, remoteSt.debts, deletedMap, remoteIsPrimary, true);
      const mergedCards = mergeCollectionById(localSt.creditCards, remoteSt.creditCards, deletedMap, remoteIsPrimary, false);
      const mergedBudgets = mergeCollectionById(localSt.budgets, remoteSt.budgets, deletedMap, remoteIsPrimary, false);
      const mergedRec = mergeCollectionById(localSt.recurringExpenses, remoteSt.recurringExpenses, deletedMap, remoteIsPrimary, false);
      const mergedGoals = mergeCollectionById(localSt.savingsGoals, remoteSt.savingsGoals, deletedMap, remoteIsPrimary, false);
      const mergedAccounts = mergeCollectionById(localSt.accounts, remoteSt.accounts, deletedMap, remoteIsPrimary, false).map(a => ({ ...a }));

      let needsPushBack = false;
      if (localHasConcurrentEdits && remoteHasConcurrentEdits) {
        const primaryIds = new Set((remoteIsPrimary ? (remoteSt.transactions || []) : (localSt.transactions || [])).map(t => String(t.id)));
        const secondaryTxs = remoteIsPrimary ? (localSt.transactions || []) : (remoteSt.transactions || []);
        const rate = Number((remoteIsPrimary ? remoteSt.exchangeRate : localSt.exchangeRate) || localSt.exchangeRate) || 41.5;

        secondaryTxs.forEach(tx => {
          if (!tx || !tx.id || primaryIds.has(String(tx.id))) return;
          if (deletedMap[String(tx.id)] && deletedMap[String(tx.id)] >= getEntityActivityTime(tx)) return;
          if (/^card_|^debt_ledger|^loan_ledger/i.test(String(tx.accountId || ''))) return;
          const amt = Math.abs(Number(tx.amount) || 0);
          if (amt <= 0) return;
          if (tx.type === 'transfer') {
            const fAcc = mergedAccounts.find(a => a.id === tx.fromAccountId);
            const tAcc = mergedAccounts.find(a => a.id === tx.toAccountId);
            if (fAcc) fAcc.balance = Number((fAcc.balance - (Number(tx.fromAmount) || amt)).toFixed(2));
            if (tAcc) tAcc.balance = Number((tAcc.balance + (Number(tx.toAmount) || amt)).toFixed(2));
          } else {
            const acc = mergedAccounts.find(a => a.id === tx.accountId) || mergedAccounts[0];
            if (acc) {
              const cur = tx.currency || 'UYU';
              const signed = (tx.type === 'income' ? 1 : -1) * amt;
              if (acc.currency === cur) acc.balance = Number((acc.balance + signed).toFixed(2));
              else if (cur === 'USD' && acc.currency === 'UYU') acc.balance = Number((acc.balance + signed * rate).toFixed(2));
              else if (cur === 'UYU' && acc.currency === 'USD') acc.balance = Number((acc.balance + signed / rate).toFixed(2));
            }
          }
          needsPushBack = true;
        });

        const baseDebtCount = (remoteIsPrimary ? (remoteSt.debts || []) : (localSt.debts || [])).length;
        if (mergedDebts.length !== baseDebtCount || mergedTx.length !== primaryIds.size) needsPushBack = true;
      }

      const nextState = {
        ...localSt,
        accounts: mergedAccounts.length ? mergedAccounts : localSt.accounts,
        budgets: mergedBudgets.length ? mergedBudgets : localSt.budgets,
        creditCards: mergedCards,
        debts: mergedDebts,
        transactions: mergedTx,
        recurringExpenses: mergedRec,
        savingsGoals: mergedGoals,
        deletedIds: deletedMap,
        exchangeRate: (remoteIsPrimary && remoteSt.exchangeRate) ? remoteSt.exchangeRate : localSt.exchangeRate,
        cloudWebhookUrl: (remoteIsPrimary && remoteSt.cloudWebhookUrl) ? remoteSt.cloudWebhookUrl : localSt.cloudWebhookUrl,
        processedCommandIds: Array.from(new Set([...(localSt.processedCommandIds || []), ...(remoteSt.processedCommandIds || [])])).slice(-200),
        externalCommandHistory: (remoteIsPrimary && Array.isArray(remoteSt.externalCommandHistory)) ? remoteSt.externalCommandHistory : (localSt.externalCommandHistory || []),
        updatedAt: needsPushBack ? Date.now() : Math.max(rTime, lTime)
      };

      return { mergedState: nextState, needsPushBack, wasConcurrentMerge: localHasConcurrentEdits && remoteHasConcurrentEdits };
    }

    async function pullStateFromGitHubCloud(manual = false) {
      if (isSyncingState) return false;
      const repo = cleanRepoSlug(), token = getActiveGitHubToken();
      if (!repo) return false;
      isSyncingState = true;
      const branch = (state.githubBranch || 'main').trim() || 'main', path = getSyncStateFilePath();
      try {
        const res = await fetch(`https://api.github.com/repos/${repo}/contents/${path}?ref=${encodeURIComponent(branch)}&t=${Date.now()}`, { headers: getGitHubHeaders(), cache: 'no-store' });
        if (res.status === 404) { isSyncingState = false; if (token) await pushStateToGitHubCloud(manual); return true; }
        if (!res.ok) { isSyncingState = false; return false; }
        const meta = await res.json();
        if (!meta || !meta.content) { isSyncingState = false; return false; }
        const remote = JSON.parse(decodeURIComponent(escape(atob(meta.content.replace(/\s/g, '')))));
        const rTime = Number(remote.updatedAt) || 0, lTime = Number(state.updatedAt) || 0;
        if (rTime !== lTime && Array.isArray(remote.accounts)) {
          const lastSynced = Number(localStorage.getItem('KRONO_LAST_SYNCED_AT') || 0);
          const localDirty = lTime > 0 && lastSynced > 0 && lTime > lastSynced;
          const remoteDirty = rTime > 0 && (lastSynced === 0 || rTime > lastSynced);

          if (rTime > lTime && !localDirty) {
            state.accounts = remote.accounts;
            state.budgets = Array.isArray(remote.budgets) ? remote.budgets : state.budgets;
            if (Array.isArray(remote.debts)) state.debts = remote.debts;
            if (Array.isArray(remote.creditCards)) state.creditCards = remote.creditCards;
            if (Array.isArray(remote.recurringExpenses)) state.recurringExpenses = remote.recurringExpenses;
            if (Array.isArray(remote.savingsGoals)) state.savingsGoals = remote.savingsGoals;
            if (remote.deletedIds && typeof remote.deletedIds === 'object') state.deletedIds = mergeDeletedIdMaps(state.deletedIds, remote.deletedIds);
            state.transactions = Array.isArray(remote.transactions) ? remote.transactions : state.transactions;
            if (remote.exchangeRate) state.exchangeRate = remote.exchangeRate;
            if (remote.cloudWebhookUrl) state.cloudWebhookUrl = remote.cloudWebhookUrl;
            if (Array.isArray(remote.processedCommandIds)) state.processedCommandIds = Array.from(new Set([...(state.processedCommandIds||[]), ...remote.processedCommandIds])).slice(-200);
            if (Array.isArray(remote.externalCommandHistory)) state.externalCommandHistory = remote.externalCommandHistory;
            state.updatedAt = rTime;
            localStorage.setItem(STORAGE_KEY, JSON.stringify(state));
            localStorage.setItem('KRONO_LAST_SYNCED_AT', String(rTime));
            if (syncChannel) syncChannel.postMessage({ type: 'SYNC_STATE', state });
            ui.syncStatusText = 'Sync ' + new Date().toLocaleTimeString('es-UY', { hour: '2-digit', minute: '2-digit' });
            isSyncingState = false; pulseSyncDot(); spawnFloatingBurst('🔄 Datos sincronizados', true); render(); return true;
          } else if (localDirty && remoteDirty) {
            const { mergedState, needsPushBack } = mergeCloudState(state, remote);
            state = mergedState;
            localStorage.setItem(STORAGE_KEY, JSON.stringify(state));
            if (syncChannel) syncChannel.postMessage({ type: 'SYNC_STATE', state });
            ui.syncStatusText = 'Fusión ' + new Date().toLocaleTimeString('es-UY', { hour: '2-digit', minute: '2-digit' });
            isSyncingState = false;
            if ((needsPushBack || state.updatedAt > rTime) && token) await pushStateToGitHubCloud(false);
            else localStorage.setItem('KRONO_LAST_SYNCED_AT', String(state.updatedAt));
            pulseSyncDot(); spawnFloatingBurst('🔀 Cambios fusionados sin conflictos', true); render(); return true;
          } else if (lTime > rTime && token) {
            isSyncingState = false; await pushStateToGitHubCloud(false);
            if (manual) { spawnFloatingBurst('✅ Cuentas sincronizadas', true); render(); }
            return true;
          }
        }
        localStorage.setItem('KRONO_LAST_SYNCED_AT', String(Math.max(rTime, lTime)));
        ui.syncStatusText = 'Al día ' + new Date().toLocaleTimeString('es-UY', { hour: '2-digit', minute: '2-digit' });
        isSyncingState = false; if (manual) { spawnFloatingBurst('✅ Todo sincronizado', true); render(); }
        return false;
      } catch (e) { isSyncingState = false; return false; }
    }

    async function consumePendingExternalCommands(pendingList) {
      if (!Array.isArray(pendingList) || pendingList.length === 0) return 0;
      if (!Array.isArray(state.processedCommandIds)) state.processedCommandIds = [];
      if (!Array.isArray(state.externalCommandHistory)) state.externalCommandHistory = [];
      const newlyProcessedIds = []; let executedCount = 0;
      for (const item of pendingList) {
        const cmdId = (typeof item === 'object' && item !== null) ? (item.id || ('cmd_' + item.timestamp)) : ('raw_' + btoa(unescape(encodeURIComponent(String(item)))).slice(0, 16));
        const rawCmd = (typeof item === 'object' && item !== null) ? (item.command || item.text || item.title || '') : String(item || '');
        if (!rawCmd.trim() || state.processedCommandIds.includes(cmdId)) continue;
        const cleanCmd = rawCmd.replace(/^(?:tarea\s+|en\s+krono\s+|krono[:\s,-]*)+/i, '').trim();
        if (cleanCmd) {
          await processGeminiCommand(cleanCmd, true);
          state.processedCommandIds.push(cmdId);
          if (state.processedCommandIds.length > 200) state.processedCommandIds.shift();
          state.externalCommandHistory.unshift({ id: cmdId, command: cleanCmd, date: new Date().toLocaleTimeString('es-UY', { hour: '2-digit', minute: '2-digit' }) });
          if (state.externalCommandHistory.length > 10) state.externalCommandHistory.pop();
          newlyProcessedIds.push(cmdId); executedCount++;
        }
      }
      if (executedCount > 0) {
        saveState(true, true);
        spawnFloatingBurst(`🤖 Google Tasks (${executedCount})`, true);
        if (state.cloudWebhookUrl) {
          try {
            await fetch(state.cloudWebhookUrl.trim(), {
              method: 'POST', mode: 'no-cors', headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
              body: JSON.stringify({ action: 'ack_commands', syncCode: state.syncCode, commandIds: newlyProcessedIds })
            });
          } catch (e) {}
        }
      }
      return executedCount;
    }

    async function pushToCloudBridge() {
      const targetUrl = (state.cloudWebhookUrl || DEFAULT_CLOUD_WEBHOOK_URL).trim();
      if (!targetUrl) return;
      try {
        await fetch(targetUrl, { method: 'POST', mode: 'no-cors', headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' }, body: JSON.stringify({ syncCode: state.syncCode, state }) });

    async function pullFromCloudBridge(manual = false) {
      if (isPollingBridge) return;
      const targetUrl = (state.cloudWebhookUrl || DEFAULT_CLOUD_WEBHOOK_URL).trim();
      if (!targetUrl) return;
      isPollingBridge = true;
      try {
        const res = await fetch(`${targetUrl}?syncCode=${encodeURIComponent(state.syncCode)}&t=${Date.now()}`, { cache: 'no-store' });
        const data = await res.json();
        let executed = 0;
        if (data && Array.isArray(data.pendingCommands) && data.pendingCommands.length > 0) {
          executed = await consumePendingExternalCommands(data.pendingCommands);
        }
        if (executed === 0 && data && data.state && Array.isArray(data.state.accounts)) {
          if ((Number(data.state.updatedAt) || 0) > (Number(state.updatedAt) || 0)) {
            const { mergedState } = mergeCloudState(state, data.state);
            state = mergedState;
            localStorage.setItem(STORAGE_KEY, JSON.stringify(state));
            localStorage.setItem('KRONO_LAST_SYNCED_AT', String(state.updatedAt || Date.now()));
            pulseSyncDot(); render();
          }
        }
        isPollingBridge = false;
        if (manual) { if (executed === 0) spawnFloatingBurst('🔄 Google Tasks al día', true); render(); }
      } catch (e) {
        isPollingBridge = false;
        if (manual) { ui.bridgeDiagnostic = '❌ Error de conexión con Apps Script'; render(); }
      }
    }

    async function applyOtaUpdatePayload(rawPayload, versionLabel = null, broadcastToCloud = true, publishRelease = false, releaseNotes = '') {
      if (!rawPayload || !String(rawPayload).trim()) return false;
      const text = String(rawPayload).trim();
      let targetHtml = null, targetVersion = (versionLabel || ('OTA-' + new Date().toLocaleDateString('es-UY'))).replace(/^v/i, '');
      if (text.startsWith('{')) {
        try {
          const parsed = JSON.parse(text);
          if (parsed.version) targetVersion = String(parsed.version).replace(/^v/i, '').trim();
          if ((parsed.css || parsed.js) && !parsed.html) {
            if (parsed.css) localStorage.setItem('KRONO_OTA_LIVE_CSS', parsed.css);
            if (parsed.js) localStorage.setItem('KRONO_OTA_LIVE_JS', parsed.js);
            localStorage.setItem('KRONO_OTA_VERSION_TAG', targetVersion);
            loadLivePatches(); ui.otaStatusMsg = `✅ Parche v${targetVersion} aplicado.`;
            spawnFloatingBurst(`🏷️ v${targetVersion}`, true); render(); return true;
          }
          if (parsed.html && (parsed.html.includes('<!DOCTYPE html>') || parsed.html.includes('<html'))) targetHtml = parsed.html;
        } catch (err) { ui.otaStatusMsg = '❌ Error al leer JSON OTA.'; render(); return false; }
      } else if (text.includes('<!DOCTYPE html>') || text.includes('<html')) {
        targetHtml = text;
        const m = text.match(/APP_BASE_VERSION\s*=\s*['"]([^'"]+)['"]/);
        if (!versionLabel && m && m[1]) targetVersion = m[1].replace(/^v/i, '');
      }
      if (targetHtml) {
        localStorage.removeItem('KRONO_OTA_LIVE_CSS');
        localStorage.removeItem('KRONO_OTA_LIVE_JS');
        localStorage.setItem('KRONO_OTA_CUSTOM_HTML', targetHtml);
        localStorage.setItem('KRONO_OTA_VERSION_TAG', targetVersion);
        state.lastReleaseTag = 'v' + targetVersion;
        localStorage.setItem(STORAGE_KEY, JSON.stringify(state));
        ui.otaStatusMsg = `✅ v${targetVersion} instalada. Reiniciando...`;
        spawnFloatingBurst(`🏷️ v${targetVersion}`, true);
        if (publishRelease && cleanRepoSlug() && getActiveGitHubToken()) await publishGitHubRelease(targetHtml, targetVersion, releaseNotes || `Release v${targetVersion}`);
        if (syncChannel) syncChannel.postMessage({ type: 'OTA_APPLIED' });
        setTimeout(() => window.location.reload(), 650);
        return true;
      }
      ui.otaStatusMsg = '⚠️ Formato OTA no reconocido.'; render(); return false;
    }

    async function fetchPayloadForReleaseTag(repo, releaseObj) {
      const tag = releaseObj.tag_name || (state.githubBranch || 'main');
      const candidates = [(state.githubFilePath || 'ota.json').trim().replace(/^\/+/, '') || 'ota.json', 'ota.json', 'index.html'];
      for (const file of candidates) {
        try {
          const res = await fetch(`https://api.github.com/repos/${repo}/contents/${file}?ref=${encodeURIComponent(tag)}&t=${Date.now()}`, { headers: getGitHubHeaders(), cache: 'no-store' });
          if (res.ok) { const m = await res.json(); if (m && m.content) return decodeURIComponent(escape(atob(m.content.replace(/\s/g, '')))); }
        } catch (e) {}
        try {
          const raw = await fetch(`https://raw.githubusercontent.com/${repo}/${encodeURIComponent(tag)}/${file}?t=${Date.now()}`, { cache: 'no-store' });
          if (raw.ok) return await raw.text();
        } catch (e) {}

    }

    async function pushSingleFileToGitHub(repo, branch, path, contentStr, commitMsg, token) {
      const apiUrl = `https://api.github.com/repos/${repo}/contents/${path}`;
      const headers = { 'Accept': 'application/vnd.github.v3+json', 'Authorization': `Bearer ${token}`, 'Content-Type': 'application/json' };
      let sha = null;
      try { const g = await fetch(`${apiUrl}?ref=${encodeURIComponent(branch)}&t=${Date.now()}`, { headers, cache: 'no-store' }); if (g.ok) { const j = await g.json(); if (j && j.sha) sha = j.sha; } } catch (e) {}
      const body = { message: commitMsg, content: btoa(unescape(encodeURIComponent(sanitizeHtmlForGitHubUpload(contentStr)))), branch };
      if (sha) body.sha = sha;
      const p = await fetch(apiUrl, { method: 'PUT', headers, body: JSON.stringify(body) });
      if (!p.ok) throw new Error('HTTP ' + p.status);
      return await p.json();
    }
    async function publishGitHubRelease(rawHtmlOrJson = null, versionTag = null, customNotes = '') {
      const repo = cleanRepoSlug(), token = getActiveGitHubToken();

      try {
        const headers = { 'Accept': 'application/vnd.github.v3+json', 'Authorization': `Bearer ${token}`, 'Content-Type': 'application/json' };
        try { const rr = await fetch(`https://api.github.com/repos/${repo}?t=${Date.now()}`, { headers, cache: 'no-store' }); if (rr.ok) { const rm = await rr.json(); if (rm && rm.default_branch) branch = rm.default_branch; } } catch (e) {}
        const ver = (versionTag || getCurrentInstalledVersion()).replace(/^v/i, ''), tagName = 'v' + ver;
        let html = localStorage.getItem('KRONO_OTA_CUSTOM_HTML') || ('<!DOCTYPE html>' + document.documentElement.outerHTML);
        if (rawHtmlOrJson) {
          const tr = String(rawHtmlOrJson).trim();
          if (tr.startsWith('{')) { const p = JSON.parse(tr); if (p.html) html = p.html; }
          else if (tr.includes('<html')) html = tr;

        const relRes = await fetch(relId ? `https://api.github.com/repos/${repo}/releases/${relId}` : `https://api.github.com/repos/${repo}/releases`, { method: relId ? 'PATCH' : 'POST', headers, body: JSON.stringify(relPayload) });

        spawnFloatingBurst(`🏷️ Subido ${tagName}`, true); render(); return true;
      } catch (e) { ui.githubPushing = false; ui.otaStatusMsg = `❌ Error: ${e.message}`; render(); return false; }
    }

    }
    function parseMonthKey(mk) {
      const m = String(mk || '').match(/^(\d{4})-(\d{2})$/);
      if (m) {
        const y = parseInt(m[1], 10), mo = parseInt(m[2], 10) - 1;
        if (y >= 2000 && y <= 2100 && mo >= 0 && mo <= 11) return { year: y, monthIdx: mo };
      }
      const d = new Date();
      return { year: d.getFullYear(), monthIdx: d.getMonth() };
    }
    function shiftMonthKey(mk, delta) {
      const { year, monthIdx } = parseMonthKey(mk);
      const d = new Date(year, monthIdx + delta, 1);
      return d.getFullYear() + '-' + String(d.getMonth() + 1).padStart(2, '0');
    }
    function formatMonthKeyLabel(mk) {
      const { year, monthIdx } = parseMonthKey(mk);
      return `${KRONO_MONTH_NAMES[monthIdx]} ${year}`;
    }
    function formatMonthKeyShort(mk) {
      const { monthIdx } = parseMonthKey(mk);
      return KRONO_MONTH_SHORT[monthIdx];
    }
    function shiftSelectedMonth(delta) {
      ui.selectedMonth = shiftMonthKey(ui.selectedMonth || getCurrentMonthKey(), delta);
      ui.aiMonthlyError = '';
      render();
    }
    function setSelectedMonth(mk) {
      ui.selectedMonth = mk || getCurrentMonthKey();
      ui.aiMonthlyError = '';
      render();
    }
    function getTxMonthKey(tx) {
      if (!tx) return getCurrentMonthKey();
      const ts = Number(tx.timestamp) || 0;
      if (ts > 1000000000) {
        const d = new Date(ts);
        if (!isNaN(d.getTime())) {
          return d.getFullYear() + '-' + String(d.getMonth() + 1).padStart(2, '0');
        }
      }
      const dm = String(tx.date || '').match(/(\d{1,2})\/(\d{1,2})(?:\/(\d{2,4}))?/);
      if (dm) {
        const mo = Math.max(1, Math.min(12, parseInt(dm[2], 10) || 1));
        const yr = dm[3] ? (dm[3].length === 2 ? 2000 + parseInt(dm[3], 10) : parseInt(dm[3], 10)) : new Date().getFullYear();
        return yr + '-' + String(mo).padStart(2, '0');
      }
      return getCurrentMonthKey();
    }
    function getTransactionsForMonth(mk = ui.selectedMonth) {
      const target = mk || getCurrentMonthKey();
      return (Array.isArray(state.transactions) ? state.transactions : []).filter(t => getTxMonthKey(t) === target);
    }
    function renderMonthSelectorPill() {
      const activeMk = ui.selectedMonth || getCurrentMonthKey();
      const isCurrent = activeMk === getCurrentMonthKey();
      return `<div class="krono-month-pill inline-flex items-center gap-1 rounded-2xl p-1 text-xs">
        <button type="button" onclick="shiftSelectedMonth(-1)" title="Mes anterior" class="krono-month-arrow w-7 h-7 rounded-xl inline-flex items-center justify-center text-cyan-200 font-extrabold">‹</button>
        <button type="button" onclick="setSelectedMonth(getCurrentMonthKey())" title="${isCurrent ? 'Mes actual' : 'Volver al mes actual'}" class="px-2.5 py-1 rounded-xl font-extrabold text-white text-xs whitespace-nowrap inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 hover:bg-white/5">
          <span>📅</span>

        </button>
        <button type="button" onclick="shiftSelectedMonth(1)" title="Mes siguiente" class="krono-month-arrow w-7 h-7 rounded-xl inline-flex items-center justify-center text-cyan-200 font-extrabold">›</button>
      </div>`;
    }
    function toDateInputValue(tsOrDate = Date.now()) {
      const d = (tsOrDate instanceof Date) ? tsOrDate : new Date(Number(tsOrDate) || Date.now());
      if (isNaN(d.getTime())) return toDateInputValue(Date.now());
      return d.getFullYear() + '-' + String(d.getMonth() + 1).padStart(2, '0') + '-' + String(d.getDate()).padStart(2, '0');
    }
    function parseDateInputToDate(dateStr, fallbackDate = new Date()) {
      const m = String(dateStr || '').trim().match(/^(\d{4})-(\d{2})-(\d{2})$/);
      if (!m) return fallbackDate;
      const y = parseInt(m[1], 10), mo = parseInt(m[2], 10) - 1, day = parseInt(m[3], 10);
      const fb = (fallbackDate instanceof Date && !isNaN(fallbackDate.getTime())) ? fallbackDate : new Date();
      return new Date(y, mo, day, fb.getHours(), fb.getMinutes(), fb.getSeconds(), 0);
    }
    function formatTxDateDisplay(dateObj = new Date()) {
      const d = (dateObj instanceof Date && !isNaN(dateObj.getTime())) ? dateObj : new Date();
      const dd = String(d.getDate()).padStart(2, '0');
      const mm = String(d.getMonth() + 1).padStart(2, '0');
      const hh = String(d.getHours()).padStart(2, '0');
      const mi = String(d.getMinutes()).padStart(2, '0');
      const nowY = new Date().getFullYear();
      return (d.getFullYear() !== nowY)
        ? `${dd}/${mm}/${String(d.getFullYear()).slice(-2)} ${hh}:${mi}`
        : `${dd}/${mm} ${hh}:${mi}`;
    }

    function getTotals(monthKey = null) {
      const rate = Number(state.exchangeRate) || 41.5;
      const targetMk = monthKey || ui.selectedMonth || getCurrentMonthKey();
      let totalUYU = 0, monthIncomeUYU = 0, monthExpenseUYU = 0;
      (Array.isArray(state.accounts) ? state.accounts : []).forEach(a => {
        totalUYU += a.currency === 'USD' ? a.balance * rate : a.balance;
      });
      const monthTxs = getTransactionsForMonth(targetMk);
      monthTxs.forEach(t => {
        if (t.type === 'transfer') return;
        const v = t.currency === 'USD' ? t.amount * rate : t.amount;
        if (t.type === 'income') monthIncomeUYU += v;
        else monthExpenseUYU += v;
      });
      return {
        monthKey: targetMk,
        monthTxCount: monthTxs.length,
        totalUYU,
        totalUSD: totalUYU / rate,
        monthIncomeUYU,
        monthExpenseUYU,
        savingsRate: monthIncomeUYU > 0 ? Math.max(0, Math.round(((monthIncomeUYU - monthExpenseUYU) / monthIncomeUYU) * 100)) : 0
      };
    }
    function formatMoney(amount, currency = 'UYU') { return (currency === 'USD' ? 'US$ ' : '$ ') + Number(amount || 0).toLocaleString('es-UY', { maximumFractionDigits: currency === 'USD' ? 2 : 0 }); }
    function addTransaction({ title, amount, currency = 'UYU', type = 'expense', category = 'Comida y Súper', accountId = null, fromExternal = false, isDebtSettlement = false, customTimestamp = null, skipSave = false }) {
      const numAmount = Math.abs(Number(amount) || 0); if (numAmount <= 0) return null;
      const rate = Number(state.exchangeRate) || 41.5;
      const normTitle = normalizeStr(title || '');
      const isSavingsIntent = /\b(ahorr[eo]|ahorrar|ahorro|pase a ahorro|reserve|reservar)\b/i.test(normTitle);

      let targetAcc = state.accounts.find(a => a.id === accountId) || state.accounts[0];
      if (isSavingsIntent) {
        const savAcc = pickBestAccountForCurrency(currency, true);
        if (savAcc) targetAcc = savAcc;
        const originAcc = pickOriginAccountForSavings(targetAcc);
        if (originAcc && targetAcc && originAcc.id !== targetAcc.id) {
          const outInOriginCur = (originAcc.currency === currency)
            ? numAmount
            : (currency === 'USD' && originAcc.currency === 'UYU' ? numAmount * rate : numAmount / rate);
          const inTargetCur = (targetAcc.currency === currency)
            ? numAmount
            : (currency === 'USD' && targetAcc.currency === 'UYU' ? numAmount * rate : numAmount / rate);
          originAcc.balance = Number((originAcc.balance - outInOriginCur).toFixed(2));
          targetAcc.balance = Number((targetAcc.balance + inTargetCur).toFixed(2));
        } else if (targetAcc) {
          const delta = numAmount;
          if (targetAcc.currency === currency) targetAcc.balance += delta;
          else if (currency === 'USD' && targetAcc.currency === 'UYU') targetAcc.balance += delta * rate;
          else if (currency === 'UYU' && targetAcc.currency === 'USD') targetAcc.balance += delta / rate;
        }
      } else if (targetAcc) {
        const delta = type === 'income' ? numAmount : -numAmount;
        if (targetAcc.currency === currency) targetAcc.balance += delta;
        else if (currency === 'USD' && targetAcc.currency === 'UYU') targetAcc.balance += delta * rate;
        else if (currency === 'UYU' && targetAcc.currency === 'USD') targetAcc.balance += delta / rate;
      }

      const txDateObj = (customTimestamp && Number(customTimestamp) > 1000000000) ? new Date(Number(customTimestamp)) : new Date();
      const originRef = isSavingsIntent ? pickOriginAccountForSavings(targetAcc) : null;
      const accDisplay = (isSavingsIntent && originRef && targetAcc && originRef.id !== targetAcc.id)
        ? `${originRef.name} → ${targetAcc.name}`
        : (targetAcc ? targetAcc.name : 'Cuenta Principal');
      const tx = {
        id: 'tx_' + Date.now() + '_' + Math.floor(Math.random() * 1000),
        title: (fromExternal ? '🤖 ' : '') + (title || 'Movimiento'),
        amount: numAmount,
        currency,
        type: isSavingsIntent ? 'expense' : type,
        category: isSavingsIntent ? 'Ahorro' : category,
        accountId: targetAcc ? targetAcc.id : 'acc_uyu',
        accountName: accDisplay,
        date: formatTxDateDisplay(txDateObj),
        timestamp: txDateObj.getTime(),
        ...(isDebtSettlement ? { isDebtSettlement: true } : {})
      };
      state.transactions.unshift(tx);
      if (!skipSave) {
        spawnFloatingBurst(`${tx.type === 'income' ? '+' : '-'}${formatMoney(numAmount, currency)} (${targetAcc ? targetAcc.name.split(' ')[0] : ''})`, tx.type === 'income');
        saveState(true, true);
      }
      return tx;
    }

        state.debts.unshift({
          id: 'debt_' + Date.now() + '_' + Math.floor(Math.random() * 1000),

        });
        const cuotaTag = instCount > 1 ? ` • ${instCount} cuotas` : '';
        state.transactions.unshift({

    }
    function resolveMatchingAccountForTx(tx) {
      if (!tx || !Array.isArray(state.accounts) || !state.accounts.length) return null;
      if (tx.accountId) {
        const byId = state.accounts.find(a => String(a.id) === String(tx.accountId));
        if (byId) return byId;
      }
      const rawAccName = String(tx.accountName || '').trim();
      const normAccName = normalizeStr(rawAccName);
      if (normAccName) {
        const byExact = state.accounts.find(a => normalizeStr(a.name) === normAccName);
        if (byExact) return byExact;
        const byIncludes = state.accounts.find(a => {
          const aN = normalizeStr(a.name);
          return (aN && normAccName.includes(aN)) || (aN && aN.includes(normAccName));
        });
        if (byIncludes) return byIncludes;
        const byMention = findAccountMentionInText(rawAccName);
        if (byMention) return byMention;
      }
      const cleanTitle = String(tx.title || '').trim();
      if (cleanTitle) {
        const byTitle = findAccountMentionInText(cleanTitle);
        if (byTitle) return byTitle;
      }
      return state.accounts.find(a => a.currency === (tx.currency || 'UYU')) || state.accounts[0];
    }

    function applyTxEffectToAccounts(tx, multiplier = 1) {
      if (!tx) return null;
      const rate = Number(state.exchangeRate) || 41.5;
      if (tx.type === 'transfer') {
        const fAcc = state.accounts.find(a => a.id === tx.fromAccountId);
        const tAcc = state.accounts.find(a => a.id === tx.toAccountId);
        const fAmt = Math.abs(Number(tx.fromAmount ?? tx.amount) || 0) * multiplier;
        const tAmt = Math.abs(Number(tx.toAmount ?? tx.amount) || 0) * multiplier;
        if (fAcc && fAmt) fAcc.balance = Number((fAcc.balance - fAmt).toFixed(2));
        if (tAcc && tAmt) tAcc.balance = Number((tAcc.balance + tAmt).toFixed(2));
        return fAcc || tAcc || null;
      }
      const amt = Math.abs(Number(tx.amount) || 0) * multiplier;
      if (amt <= 0) return null;
      const cur = tx.currency || 'UYU';

      // Check if it was a savings move between two accounts ("Origen → Destino")
      if (tx.category === 'Ahorro' && typeof tx.accountName === 'string' && tx.accountName.includes(' → ')) {
        const parts = tx.accountName.split(' → ');
        const originName = normalizeStr(parts[0] || '');
        const destName = normalizeStr(parts[1] || '');
        const originAcc = state.accounts.find(a => normalizeStr(a.name) === originName) || findAccountMentionInText(parts[0] || '');
        const destAcc = state.accounts.find(a => normalizeStr(a.name) === destName) || findAccountMentionInText(parts[1] || '') || state.accounts.find(a => a.id === tx.accountId);
        if (originAcc && destAcc && originAcc.id !== destAcc.id) {
          const outInOrigin = (originAcc.currency === cur) ? amt : (cur === 'USD' && originAcc.currency === 'UYU' ? amt * rate : amt / rate);
          const inDest = (destAcc.currency === cur) ? amt : (cur === 'USD' && destAcc.currency === 'UYU' ? amt * rate : amt / rate);
          originAcc.balance = Number((originAcc.balance - outInOrigin).toFixed(2));
          destAcc.balance = Number((destAcc.balance + inDest).toFixed(2));
          return destAcc;
        }
      }

      const acc = resolveMatchingAccountForTx(tx);
      if (acc) {
        const signed = (tx.type === 'income' ? 1 : -1) * amt;
        if (acc.currency === cur) acc.balance = Number((acc.balance + signed).toFixed(2));
        else if (cur === 'USD' && acc.currency === 'UYU') acc.balance = Number((acc.balance + signed * rate).toFixed(2));
        else if (cur === 'UYU' && acc.currency === 'USD') acc.balance = Number((acc.balance + signed / rate).toFixed(2));
        return acc;
      }
      return null;
    }

    function openEditTransactionModal(txId) {
      const tx = (state.transactions || []).find(t => t.id === txId);
      if (!tx) return;
      ui.editingTxId = txId;
      render();
    }

    function handleEditTransactionSubmit(e) {
      if (e) e.preventDefault();
      const idx = (state.transactions || []).findIndex(t => t.id === ui.editingTxId);
      if (idx === -1) return;
      const oldTx = state.transactions[idx];
      const newTitle = (document.getElementById('etx-title').value || '').trim() || 'Movimiento';
      const newAmount = Math.abs(parseFloat(document.getElementById('etx-amount').value) || 0);
      if (!newAmount || newAmount <= 0) return;
      const newCurrency = document.getElementById('etx-currency').value || 'UYU';
      const newType = document.getElementById('etx-type').value || 'expense';
      const newCategory = document.getElementById('etx-category').value || 'General';
      const newAccId = document.getElementById('etx-account').value;
      const targetAcc = state.accounts.find(a => a.id === newAccId) || state.accounts[0];
      const newDateStr = document.getElementById('etx-date') ? document.getElementById('etx-date').value : '';
      let newTs = Number(oldTx.timestamp) || Date.now();
      let newDateDisplay = oldTx.date;
      if (newDateStr && newDateStr !== toDateInputValue(newTs)) {
        const dtObj = parseDateInputToDate(newDateStr, new Date(newTs));
        newTs = dtObj.getTime();
        newDateDisplay = formatTxDateDisplay(dtObj);
      }

      // Revert old effect from accounts first
      applyTxEffectToAccounts(oldTx, -1);

      const updatedTx = {
        ...oldTx,
        title: newTitle,
        amount: newAmount,
        currency: newCurrency,
        type: newType,
        category: newCategory,
        accountId: targetAcc ? targetAcc.id : oldTx.accountId,
        accountName: targetAcc ? targetAcc.name : oldTx.accountName,
        timestamp: newTs,
        date: newDateDisplay,
        updatedAt: Date.now()
      };

      // Apply new effect to accounts
      applyTxEffectToAccounts(updatedTx, 1);
      state.transactions[idx] = updatedTx;
      ui.editingTxId = null;
      spawnFloatingBurst(`✏️ ${updatedTx.title} (${formatMoney(updatedTx.amount, updatedTx.currency)})`, updatedTx.type === 'income');
      saveState(true, true);
    }

    function deleteTransaction(txId) {
      const idx = state.transactions.findIndex(t => t.id === txId); if (idx === -1) return;
      const tx = state.transactions[idx];
      const isTransfer = tx.type === 'transfer';
      const previewAcc = resolveMatchingAccountForTx(tx);
      const accDesc = previewAcc ? `"${escapeAttr(previewAcc.name)}"` : 'la cuenta asociada';
      openConfirmModal({
        title: isTransfer ? '↩️ Deshacer Transferencia' : '🗑️ Eliminar Movimiento y Devolver Saldo',
        message: isTransfer
          ? `¿Querés deshacer "${escapeAttr(tx.title)}" (${formatMoney(tx.fromAmount ?? tx.amount, tx.fromCurrency || tx.currency)}) y devolver los saldos a ambas cuentas?`
          : `¿Querés eliminar "${escapeAttr(tx.title)}" (${formatMoney(tx.amount, tx.currency)}) y devolver el impacto directamente en ${accDesc}?`,
        confirmText: isTransfer ? 'Deshacer Transferencia' : 'Eliminar y Devolver',
        danger: true,
        onConfirm: () => {
          const curIdx = state.transactions.findIndex(t => t.id === txId);
          if (curIdx === -1) return;
          const removedTx = state.transactions[curIdx];
          recordDeletedId(removedTx.id);
          const touchedAcc = applyTxEffectToAccounts(removedTx, -1);
          if (!isTransfer && Array.isArray(state.debts)) {
            const cleanTitle = normalizeStr(String(removedTx.title || '').replace(/^🤖\s*/, ''));
            state.debts = state.debts.filter(d => {
              const dTitleNorm = normalizeStr(d.title || '');
              const matchesDebtTitle = dTitleNorm && cleanTitle.includes(dTitleNorm) && Math.abs(Number(d.amount || 0) - Number(removedTx.amount || 0)) < 0.01;
              if (matchesDebtTitle) recordDeletedId(d.id);
              return !matchesDebtTitle;
            });
          }
          state.transactions.splice(curIdx, 1);
          if (ui.editingTxId === txId) ui.editingTxId = null;
          state.updatedAt = Date.now();
          localStorage.setItem(STORAGE_KEY, JSON.stringify(state));
          spawnFloatingBurst(`🗑️ Saldo devuelto${touchedAcc ? ' en ' + touchedAcc.name.split(' ')[0] : ''}`, true);
          saveState(true, true);
        }
      });
    }

      const a = document.createElement('a'); a.href = URL.createObjectURL(new Blob([rows.join('\n')], { type: 'text/csv;charset=utf-8;' })); a.download = `Krono_Movimientos_${new Date().toISOString().slice(0,10)}.csv`; a.click();
    }

    function getDebtRemainingAmount(d) {

    function getActiveTempLimitIncrease(cardObj, rate = 41.5) {

    function getDebtsCardsBreakdown() {
      const rate = Number(state.exchangeRate) || 41.5;
      const list = Array.isArray(state.debts) ? state.debts : [];
      const savedCards = Array.isArray(state.creditCards) ? state.creditCards : [];
      const map = new Map();
      savedCards.forEach(sc => {
        const label = (sc.name || '').trim();
        if (!label) return;
        const key = label.toLowerCase();
        const baseLim = Math.max(0, Number(sc.creditLimit) || 0);
        const tempTarget = getActiveTempLimitIncrease(sc, rate);
        const effLim = getEffectiveCardLimit(sc, rate);
        const tempExtraDiff = Math.max(0, Number((effLim - baseLim).toFixed(2)));
        const activeTempList = Array.isArray(sc.tempLimitIncreases) ? sc.tempLimitIncreases.filter(isTempIncreaseActive) : [];
        if (!map.has(key)) {
          map.set(key, {
            id: sc.id,
            name: label,
            currency: sc.currency || 'UYU',
            baseLimit: baseLim,
            tempTargetLimit: tempTarget,
            tempLimitIncrease: tempExtraDiff,
            activeTempIncreasesCount: activeTempList.length,
            effectiveLimit: effLim,
            closingDay: sc.closingDay || '',
            dueDay: sc.dueDay || '',
            totalItems: 0,
            pendingItems: 0,
            activeInstallmentPlans: 0,
            remainingInstallmentsTotal: 0,
            nextPaymentUYU: 0,
            remainingBalanceUYU: 0,
            dueDates: sc.dueDay ? ['Día ' + sc.dueDay] : []
          });
        }
      });
      list.forEach(d => {
        const cardLabel = getDebtInstrumentLabel(d);

        if (!map.has(key)) {
          map.set(key, {

            currency: d.currency || 'UYU',
            baseLimit: 0,
            tempLimitIncrease: 0,

            effectiveLimit: 0,
            totalItems: 0,
            pendingItems: 0,

            nextPaymentUYU: 0,
            remainingBalanceUYU: 0,
            dueDates: []

          entry.pendingItems++;
          const rem = getDebtRemainingAmount(d);
          const instCount = Math.max(1, parseInt(d.installmentsCount, 10) || 1);
          const paidInst = Math.max(0, Math.min(instCount, parseInt(d.paidInstallments, 10) || 0));

          const instVal = getDebtInstallmentValue(d);
          const payNow = instCount > 1 ? Math.min(rem, instVal) : rem;
          const sign = d.kind === 'credit' ? -1 : 1;
          entry.remainingBalanceUYU += sign * (d.currency === 'USD' ? rem * rate : rem);
          entry.nextPaymentUYU += sign * (d.currency === 'USD' ? payNow * rate : payNow);

        const cardCur = entry.currency || 'UYU';
        const usedInCardCur = cardCur === 'USD'
          ? Number((Math.max(0, entry.remainingBalanceUYU) / rate).toFixed(2))
          : Math.max(0, entry.remainingBalanceUYU);
        const effLim = Math.max(0, Number(entry.effectiveLimit) || 0);
        const availLim = effLim > 0 ? Number((effLim - usedInCardCur).toFixed(2)) : null;
        const usedPct = effLim > 0 ? Math.min(100, Math.max(0, Math.round((usedInCardCur / effLim) * 100))) : 0;

    function parseClosingDayNumber(rawVal) {
      if (rawVal === null || rawVal === undefined) return null;
      const m = String(rawVal).match(/(\d{1,2})/);
      if (!m) return null;
      const day = parseInt(m[1], 10);
      return (day >= 1 && day <= 31) ? day : null;
    }
    function makeClampedMonthDate(year, monthIdx, day, endOfDay = false) {
      const lastDay = new Date(year, monthIdx + 1, 0).getDate();
      const clamped = Math.max(1, Math.min(day, lastDay));
      return endOfDay
        ? new Date(year, monthIdx, clamped, 23, 59, 59, 999)
        : new Date(year, monthIdx, clamped, 0, 0, 0, 0);
    }
    function getCardClosingCycleDates(closingDay, now = new Date()) {
      const y = now.getFullYear(), m = now.getMonth();
      if (closingDay && closingDay >= 1 && closingDay <= 31) {
        const thisMonthClose = makeClampedMonthDate(y, m, closingDay, true);
        if (now.getDate() >= closingDay) {
          return {
            hasClosingDay: true,
            currentClosingDate: thisMonthClose,
            nextClosingDate: makeClampedMonthDate(y, m + 1, closingDay, true)
          };
        }
        return {
          hasClosingDay: true,
          currentClosingDate: makeClampedMonthDate(y, m - 1, closingDay, true),
          nextClosingDate: thisMonthClose
        };
      }
      return {
        hasClosingDay: false,
        currentClosingDate: new Date(y, m, 0, 23, 59, 59, 999),
        nextClosingDate: new Date(y, m + 1, 0, 23, 59, 59, 999)
      };
    }
    function formatShortDayMonth(dateObj) {
      if (!dateObj || isNaN(dateObj.getTime())) return '';
      return `${String(dateObj.getDate()).padStart(2, '0')}/${String(dateObj.getMonth() + 1).padStart(2, '0')}`;
    }
    function formatCardClosingAndDueDates(cardObj, now = new Date()) {
      if (!cardObj) return '';
      const rawClose = String(cardObj.closingDay || '').trim();
      const rawDue = String(cardObj.dueDay || '').trim();
      const closeDay = parseClosingDayNumber(rawClose);
      const dueDay = parseClosingDayNumber(rawDue);
      const y = now.getFullYear(), m = now.getMonth();
      const parts = [];
      let closeDateObj = null;

      if (rawClose) {
        if (/^\d{1,2}\/\d{1,2}/.test(rawClose)) {
          parts.push('Cierre ' + rawClose);
        } else if (closeDay) {
          const thisMonthClose = makeClampedMonthDate(y, m, closeDay, true);
          closeDateObj = (now.getTime() <= thisMonthClose.getTime())
            ? thisMonthClose
            : makeClampedMonthDate(y, m + 1, closeDay, true);
          parts.push('Cierre ' + formatShortDayMonth(closeDateObj));
        } else {
          parts.push('Cierre ' + rawClose);
        }
      }

      if (rawDue) {
        if (/^\d{1,2}\/\d{1,2}/.test(rawDue)) {
          parts.push('Vto. ' + rawDue);
        } else if (dueDay) {
          let dueDateObj = null;
          if (closeDateObj && closeDay) {
            const dueMonthOffset = (dueDay > closeDay) ? 0 : 1;
            dueDateObj = makeClampedMonthDate(closeDateObj.getFullYear(), closeDateObj.getMonth() + dueMonthOffset, dueDay, true);
          } else {
            const thisMonthDue = makeClampedMonthDate(y, m, dueDay, true);
            dueDateObj = (now.getTime() <= thisMonthDue.getTime())
              ? thisMonthDue
              : makeClampedMonthDate(y, m + 1, dueDay, true);
          }
          parts.push('Vto. ' + formatShortDayMonth(dueDateObj));
        } else {
          parts.push('Vto. ' + rawDue);
        }
      }

      return parts.join(' • ');
    }
    function autoFillNewTxCardDates(cardNameValue) {

    function getSavedCardMetaForDebt(d) {
      const cards = Array.isArray(state.creditCards) ? state.creditCards : [];
      if (!cards.length || !d) return null;
      const label = normalizeStr(getDebtInstrumentLabel(d) || d.cardName || d.counterparty || '');

    function wasDebtPaidAfterTimestamp(d, cardMeta, cutoffMs) {
      const lastPaid = Number(d && d.lastPaidAt) || 0;
      if (lastPaid > cutoffMs) return true;
      const paidInst = Math.max(0, parseInt(d && d.paidInstallments, 10) || 0);
      if (paidInst <= 0) return false;
      const txs = Array.isArray(state.transactions) ? state.transactions : [];
      const dTitleNorm = normalizeStr((d && d.title) || '');
      const cardNorm = normalizeStr((cardMeta && cardMeta.name) || (d && d.cardName) || '');
      return txs.some(tx => {
        if (!tx || tx.type !== 'expense') return false;
        const ts = Number(tx.timestamp) || 0;
        if (ts <= cutoffMs) return false;
        const tNorm = normalizeStr(tx.title || '');
        if (dTitleNorm && /^(?:🤖\s*)?pago\s*:/.test(tNorm) && tNorm.includes(dTitleNorm)) return true;
        if (/^(?:🤖\s*)?(?:cuotas del mes|saldo total|pago\s+tarjeta)/.test(tNorm)) {
          if (!cardNorm || tNorm.includes(cardNorm) || normalizeStr(tx.accountName || '').includes(cardNorm)) return true;
        }
        return false;
      });

    function getDebtOriginTimestamp(d, fallbackMs = Date.now()) {
      const explicitTs = Number(d && d.createdAt) || 0;
      if (explicitTs > 1000000000) return explicitTs;
      const m = String((d && d.id) || '').match(/(\d{13})/);
      if (m) {
        const parsed = Number(m[1]);
        if (parsed > 1000000000) return parsed;
      }
      return fallbackMs;

    function getDateMonthKey(dateObj) {
      if (!dateObj || isNaN(dateObj.getTime())) return '';
      return dateObj.getFullYear() + '-' + String(dateObj.getMonth() + 1).padStart(2, '0');
    }

    function getDebtClosingSchedule(d, cardMeta = null, now = new Date()) {
      const meta = cardMeta || getSavedCardMetaForDebt(d);
      const closingDay = parseClosingDayNumber(meta ? meta.closingDay : null);
      const dueDay = parseClosingDayNumber(meta ? meta.dueDay : null);
      const cycle = getCardClosingCycleDates(closingDay, now);
      const instCount = Math.max(1, parseInt(d && d.installmentsCount, 10) || 1);
      const paidInst = Math.max(0, Math.min(instCount, parseInt(d && d.paidInstallments, 10) || 0));
      const originMs = getDebtOriginTimestamp(d, now.getTime());
      const originDate = new Date(originMs);
      const cy = originDate.getFullYear(), cm = originDate.getMonth();

      if (cycle.hasClosingDay) {
        const sameMonthClose = makeClampedMonthDate(cy, cm, closingDay, true);
        const firstYear = cy;
        const firstMonth = (originMs <= sameMonthClose.getTime()) ? cm : (cm + 1);
        const nextClosingDate = makeClampedMonthDate(firstYear, firstMonth + paidInst, closingDay, true);
        let nextDueDate = null;
        if (dueDay) {
          const dueMonthOffset = (dueDay > closingDay) ? 0 : 1;
          nextDueDate = makeClampedMonthDate(nextClosingDate.getFullYear(), nextClosingDate.getMonth() + dueMonthOffset, dueDay, true);
        }
        const isCurrentClosing = nextClosingDate.getTime() <= cycle.currentClosingDate.getTime();
        return {
          hasClosingDay: true,
          closingDay,
          dueDay,
          cycle,
          nextClosingDate,
          nextDueDate,
          nextClosingMonthKey: getDateMonthKey(nextClosingDate),
          isCurrentClosing
        };
      }

      // Card without explicit closingDay: advance virtual monthly cycle by paidInst
      const nextClosingDate = new Date(cy, cm + paidInst + 1, 0, 23, 59, 59, 999);
      const paidCurrentCycle = wasDebtPaidAfterTimestamp(d, meta, cycle.currentClosingDate.getTime());
      const isCurrentClosing = (paidInst === 0 && !paidCurrentCycle);
      return {
        hasClosingDay: false,
        closingDay: null,
        dueDay,
        cycle,
        nextClosingDate,
        nextDueDate: null,
        nextClosingMonthKey: getDateMonthKey(nextClosingDate),
        isCurrentClosing
      };
    }

    function updateDebtDueDateForNextCycle(d) {
      if (!d || d.status === 'settled') return;
      const cardMeta = getSavedCardMetaForDebt(d);
      if (!cardMeta) return;
      const sched = getDebtClosingSchedule(d, cardMeta, new Date());
      if (!sched || !sched.hasClosingDay || !sched.nextClosingDate) return;
      const curDue = String(d.dueDate || '').trim();
      if (curDue && !/cierre|vto|d[ií]a|^\d{1,2}\/\d{1,2}$/i.test(curDue)) return;
      const parts = ['Cierre ' + formatShortDayMonth(sched.nextClosingDate)];
      if (sched.nextDueDate) parts.push('Vto. ' + formatShortDayMonth(sched.nextDueDate));
      d.dueDate = parts.join(' • ');
    }

    function getDebtsSummary() {
      const rate = Number(state.exchangeRate) || 41.5;
      const list = Array.isArray(state.debts) ? state.debts : [];
      const now = new Date();
      let pendingCreditsUYU = 0, pendingDebtsUYU = 0, pendingCount = 0, nextInstallmentsUYU = 0;
      list.forEach(d => {
        if (d.status !== 'settled') {
          pendingCount++;
          const rem = getDebtRemainingAmount(d);
          const v = (d.currency === 'USD' ? rem * rate : rem);
          const instVal = getDebtInstallmentValue(d);
          const instV = (d.currency === 'USD' ? instVal * rate : instVal);
          if (d.kind === 'credit') {
            pendingCreditsUYU += v;
          } else {
            pendingDebtsUYU += v;
            nextInstallmentsUYU += instV;
          }
        }
      });

      let currentCardClosingUYU = 0;
      let currentClosingDateObj = null;
      const upcomingEntries = [];

      list.forEach(d => {
        if (d.status !== 'settled' && d.kind !== 'credit') {
          const cardMeta = getSavedCardMetaForDebt(d);
          const hasCard = Boolean(cardMeta) || d.paymentMethod === 'credit_card' || Boolean((d.cardName || '').trim()) || /tarjeta|visa|master|oca|amex|cabal|zodimac|brou|itau|itaú|santander|bbva|scotia|prex|midinero/i.test(`${d.title || ''} ${d.counterparty || ''}`);
          if (hasCard) {
            const rem = getDebtRemainingAmount(d);
            if (rem <= 0.01) return;
            const instCount = Math.max(1, parseInt(d.installmentsCount, 10) || 1);
            const instVal = getDebtInstallmentValue(d);
            const payClosing = instCount > 1 ? Math.min(rem, instVal) : rem;
            const payClosingUYU = (d.currency === 'USD' ? payClosing * rate : payClosing);
            const sched = getDebtClosingSchedule(d, cardMeta, now);

            if (sched.isCurrentClosing) {
              currentCardClosingUYU += payClosingUYU;
              if (sched.hasClosingDay && (!currentClosingDateObj || sched.nextClosingDate < currentClosingDateObj)) {
                currentClosingDateObj = sched.nextClosingDate;
              }
            } else {
              upcomingEntries.push({ payClosingUYU, sched });
            }
          }
        }
      });

      let nextCardClosingUYU = 0;
      let nextClosingDateObj = null;
      if (upcomingEntries.length > 0) {
        let minDated = null;
        upcomingEntries.forEach(e => {
          if (e.sched.hasClosingDay && e.sched.nextClosingDate) {
            if (!minDated || e.sched.nextClosingDate < minDated) minDated = e.sched.nextClosingDate;
          }
        });
        if (minDated) {
          nextClosingDateObj = minDated;
          const targetMk = getDateMonthKey(minDated);
          upcomingEntries.forEach(e => {
            if (!e.sched.hasClosingDay || e.sched.nextClosingMonthKey === targetMk) {
              nextCardClosingUYU += e.payClosingUYU;
            }
          });
        } else {
          upcomingEntries.forEach(e => { nextCardClosingUYU += e.payClosingUYU; });
        }
      }

      const hasPendingCurrentClosing = currentCardClosingUYU > 0.01;
      const cardClosingMode = hasPendingCurrentClosing ? 'current' : 'next';
      const displayCardClosingUYU = Math.abs(hasPendingCurrentClosing ? currentCardClosingUYU : nextCardClosingUYU);
      const cardClosingLabel = hasPendingCurrentClosing ? 'Cierre Actual' : 'Próximo Cierre';
      const activeClosingDate = hasPendingCurrentClosing ? currentClosingDateObj : nextClosingDateObj;
      const cardClosingDateLabel = activeClosingDate ? formatShortDayMonth(activeClosingDate) : '';
      return {
        pendingCreditsUYU,
        pendingDebtsUYU,
        nextInstallmentsUYU,
        currentCardClosingUYU,
        nextCardClosingUYU,
        cardClosingMode,
        displayCardClosingUYU,
        cardClosingLabel,
        cardClosingDateLabel,
        netPendingUYU: pendingCreditsUYU - pendingDebtsUYU,
        pendingCount
      };
    }
    function isDebtCardInstrument(d) {
      if (!d) return false;
      const cardMeta = getSavedCardMetaForDebt(d);
      return Boolean(cardMeta) || d.paymentMethod === 'credit_card' || Boolean((d.cardName || '').trim()) || /tarjeta|visa|master|oca|amex|cabal|zodimac|brou|itau|itaú|santander|bbva|scotia|prex|midinero/i.test(`${d.title || ''} ${d.counterparty || ''}`);
    }

    function getRealAvailableBreakdown(totals, ds, monthKey = ui.selectedMonth) {
      const rate = Number(state.exchangeRate) || 41.5;
      const targetMk = monthKey || getCurrentMonthKey();
      const cardCurrentClosingUYU = (ds && ds.currentCardClosingUYU > 0.01) ? ds.currentCardClosingUYU : 0;
      let otherPendingDebtsUYU = 0;
      (Array.isArray(state.debts) ? state.debts : []).forEach(d => {
        if (d.status !== 'settled' && d.kind !== 'credit' && !isDebtCardInstrument(d)) {
          const rem = getDebtRemainingAmount(d);
          const instCount = Math.max(1, parseInt(d.installmentsCount, 10) || 1);
          const instVal = getDebtInstallmentValue(d);
          const dueNow = instCount > 1 ? Math.min(rem, instVal) : rem;
          otherPendingDebtsUYU += (d.currency === 'USD' ? dueNow * rate : dueNow);
        }
      });
      let unpaidRecurringUYU = 0;
      (Array.isArray(state.recurringExpenses) ? state.recurringExpenses : []).forEach(rec => {
        if (rec.payMode === 'credit_card') return;
        const paidArr = Array.isArray(rec.paidMonths) ? rec.paidMonths : [];
        if (!paidArr.includes(targetMk)) {
          const amt = Math.abs(Number(rec.amount) || 0);
          unpaidRecurringUYU += (rec.currency === 'USD' ? amt * rate : amt);
        }
      });
      const committedUYU = Number((cardCurrentClosingUYU + otherPendingDebtsUYU + unpaidRecurringUYU).toFixed(2));
      const freeUYU = Number(((totals ? totals.totalUYU : 0) - committedUYU).toFixed(2));
      return {
        committedUYU,
        committedUSD: committedUYU / rate,
        freeUYU,
        freeUSD: freeUYU / rate,
        cardCurrentClosingUYU,
        otherPendingDebtsUYU,
        unpaidRecurringUYU
      };
    }

    function getCardClosingBreakdown(cardName) {
      const rate = Number(state.exchangeRate) || 41.5;
      const now = new Date();
      const targetNorm = normalizeStr(cardName || '');
      const cards = Array.isArray(state.creditCards) ? state.creditCards : [];
      const cardMeta = cards.find(c => normalizeStr(c.name || '') === targetNorm) || null;

      const cardDebts = (Array.isArray(state.debts) ? state.debts : []).filter(d => {
        if (d.status === 'settled' || d.kind === 'credit') return false;
        const lbl = normalizeStr(getDebtInstrumentLabel(d) || d.cardName || d.counterparty || '');
        return lbl && (lbl === targetNorm || lbl.includes(targetNorm) || targetNorm.includes(lbl));
      });

      const currentItems = [], upcomingItems = [];
      let currentUYU = 0, fullBalanceUYU = 0;
      let earliestCurrentDate = null;

      cardDebts.forEach(d => {
        const rem = getDebtRemainingAmount(d);
        if (rem <= 0.01) return;
        const instCount = Math.max(1, parseInt(d.installmentsCount, 10) || 1);
        const paidInst = Math.max(0, Math.min(instCount, parseInt(d.paidInstallments, 10) || 0));
        const instVal = getDebtInstallmentValue(d);
        const payNow = instCount > 1 ? Math.min(rem, instVal) : rem;
        const payNowUYU = (d.currency === 'USD' ? payNow * rate : payNow);
        const remUYU = (d.currency === 'USD' ? rem * rate : rem);
        fullBalanceUYU += remUYU;

        const sched = getDebtClosingSchedule(d, cardMeta, now);
        const itemObj = {
          debt: d,
          payNow,
          payNowUYU,
          rem,
          remUYU,
          instCount,
          nextInstNum: Math.min(instCount, paidInst + 1),
          sched
        };
        if (sched.isCurrentClosing) {
          currentItems.push(itemObj);
          currentUYU += payNowUYU;
          if (sched.hasClosingDay && (!earliestCurrentDate || sched.nextClosingDate < earliestCurrentDate)) {
            earliestCurrentDate = sched.nextClosingDate;
          }
        } else {
          upcomingItems.push(itemObj);
        }
      });

      const useCurrent = currentItems.length > 0;
      let activeItems = currentItems;
      let activeUYU = currentUYU;
      let activeDate = earliestCurrentDate;

      if (!useCurrent && upcomingItems.length > 0) {
        let minUpcomingDate = null;
        upcomingItems.forEach(it => {
          if (it.sched.hasClosingDay && it.sched.nextClosingDate) {
            if (!minUpcomingDate || it.sched.nextClosingDate < minUpcomingDate) {
              minUpcomingDate = it.sched.nextClosingDate;
            }
          }
        });
        if (minUpcomingDate) {
          const targetMk = getDateMonthKey(minUpcomingDate);
          activeItems = upcomingItems.filter(it => !it.sched.hasClosingDay || it.sched.nextClosingMonthKey === targetMk);
          activeDate = minUpcomingDate;
        } else {
          activeItems = upcomingItems;
          activeDate = null;
        }
        activeUYU = activeItems.reduce((s, it) => s + it.payNowUYU, 0);
      }

      return {
        cardName: cardMeta ? cardMeta.name : cardName,
        mode: useCurrent ? 'current' : 'next',
        label: useCurrent ? 'Cierre Actual' : 'Próximo Cierre',
        dateLabel: activeDate ? formatShortDayMonth(activeDate) : '',
        closingTotalUYU: Number(activeUYU.toFixed(2)),
        fullBalanceUYU: Number(fullBalanceUYU.toFixed(2)),
        items: activeItems,
        allItems: cardDebts
      };
    }

    function getPendingCardsForClosingPay() {
      return getDebtsCardsBreakdown().filter(c => c.pendingItems > 0);
