    function handlePayCardClosingSubmit(e) {
      if (e) e.preventDefault();
      const cardName = ui.payCardClosingName;
      if (!cardName) return;
      const accId = document.getElementById('pcc-account') ? document.getElementById('pcc-account').value : '';
      const scope = document.getElementById('pcc-scope') ? document.getElementById('pcc-scope').value : 'closing';
      const sourceAcc = (state.accounts || []).find(a => a.id === accId) || (state.accounts && state.accounts[0]);
      const info = getCardClosingBreakdown(cardName);
      const rate = Number(state.exchangeRate) || 41.5;

      let totalPaidUYU = 0;
      let countTouched = 0;

      if (scope === 'full') {
        info.allItems.forEach(d => {
          const rem = getDebtRemainingAmount(d);
          if (rem <= 0.01) return;
          const instCount = Math.max(1, parseInt(d.installmentsCount, 10) || 1);
          d.paidInstallments = instCount;
          d.lastPaidAt = Date.now();
          d.status = 'settled';
          d.settledAt = Date.now();
          totalPaidUYU += (d.currency === 'USD' ? rem * rate : rem);
          countTouched++;
        });
      } else {
        info.items.forEach(it => {
          const d = it.debt;
          const rem = getDebtRemainingAmount(d);
          if (rem <= 0.01) return;
          const instCount = Math.max(1, parseInt(d.installmentsCount, 10) || 1);
          const paidInst = Math.max(0, Math.min(instCount, parseInt(d.paidInstallments, 10) || 0));
          const nextPaid = Math.min(instCount, paidInst + 1);
          d.paidInstallments = nextPaid;
          d.lastPaidAt = Date.now();
          if (nextPaid >= instCount || getDebtRemainingAmount(d) <= 0.01) {
            d.status = 'settled';
            d.settledAt = Date.now();
          } else {
            updateDebtDueDateForNextCycle(d);
          }
          totalPaidUYU += it.payNowUYU;
          countTouched++;
        });
      }

      if (countTouched <= 0 || totalPaidUYU <= 0) {
        ui.showPayCardClosingModal = false;
        ui.payCardClosingName = null;
        render();
        return;
      }

      const accCur = sourceAcc ? sourceAcc.currency : 'UYU';
      const deductAmt = accCur === 'USD' ? Number((totalPaidUYU / rate).toFixed(2)) : Math.round(totalPaidUYU);
      if (sourceAcc) {
        sourceAcc.balance = Number((sourceAcc.balance - deductAmt).toFixed(2));
      }
      const now = new Date();
      const dateTag = info.dateLabel ? ` ${info.dateLabel}` : '';
      const labelTitle = scope === 'full'
        ? `Pago saldo total ${info.cardName} (${countTouched} ${countTouched === 1 ? 'ítem' : 'ítems'})`
        : `Pago ${info.label}${dateTag} ${info.cardName} (${countTouched} ${countTouched === 1 ? 'cuota' : 'cuotas'})`;
      state.transactions.unshift({
        id: 'tx_pcc_' + Date.now() + '_' + Math.floor(Math.random() * 1000),
        title: labelTitle,
        amount: deductAmt,
        currency: accCur,
        type: 'expense',
        category: 'Tarjeta / Crédito',
        accountId: sourceAcc ? sourceAcc.id : 'acc_uyu',
        accountName: sourceAcc ? sourceAcc.name : 'Cuenta Principal',
        date: `${String(now.getDate()).padStart(2,'0')}/${String(now.getMonth()+1).padStart(2,'0')} ${String(now.getHours()).padStart(2,'0')}:${String(now.getMinutes()).padStart(2,'0')}`,
        timestamp: Date.now(),
        isDebtSettlement: true
      });

      ui.showPayCardClosingModal = false;
      ui.payCardClosingName = null;
      spawnFloatingBurst(`✅ ${info.label}${dateTag} ${info.cardName} pagado (-${formatMoney(deductAmt, accCur)})`, true);
      saveState(true, true);
    }

    function getInstallmentsTimeline6Months() {
      const rate = Number(state.exchangeRate) || 41.5;
      const now = new Date();
      const baseMk = getCurrentMonthKey();
      const nowY = now.getFullYear(), nowM = now.getMonth();
      const buckets = [];
      for (let i = 0; i < 6; i++) {
        const mk = shiftMonthKey(baseMk, i);
        buckets.push({
          offset: i,
          monthKey: mk,
          shortLabel: formatMonthKeyShort(mk),
          fullLabel: formatMonthKeyLabel(mk),
          totalUYU: 0,
          count: 0
        });
      }
      let maxFinishOffset = -1;
      let totalPendingPlans = 0;

      (Array.isArray(state.debts) ? state.debts : []).forEach(d => {
        if (d.status === 'settled' || d.kind === 'credit') return;
        const rem = getDebtRemainingAmount(d);
        if (rem <= 0.01) return;
        totalPendingPlans++;
        const instCount = Math.max(1, parseInt(d.installmentsCount, 10) || 1);
        const paidInst = Math.max(0, Math.min(instCount, parseInt(d.paidInstallments, 10) || 0));
        const remInst = Math.max(1, instCount - paidInst);
        const instVal = getDebtInstallmentValue(d);

        let startOffset = 0;
        if (isDebtCardInstrument(d)) {
          const cardMeta = getSavedCardMetaForDebt(d);
          const sched = getDebtClosingSchedule(d, cardMeta, now);
          if (sched.isCurrentClosing) {
            startOffset = 0;
          } else if (sched.nextClosingDate) {
            const diffMonths = (sched.nextClosingDate.getFullYear() - nowY) * 12 + (sched.nextClosingDate.getMonth() - nowM);
            startOffset = Math.max(1, diffMonths);
          } else {
            startOffset = 1;
          }
        }

        const finishOffset = startOffset + remInst;
        if (finishOffset > maxFinishOffset) maxFinishOffset = finishOffset;

        let remTracker = rem;
        for (let k = 0; k < remInst; k++) {
          const idx = startOffset + k;
          const piece = (k === remInst - 1) ? remTracker : Math.min(remTracker, instVal);
          remTracker = Math.max(0, remTracker - piece);
          if (idx >= 0 && idx < 6) {
            const valUYU = d.currency === 'USD' ? piece * rate : piece;
            buckets[idx].totalUYU += valUYU;
            buckets[idx].count++;
          }
        }
      });

      const maxVal = Math.max(1, ...buckets.map(b => b.totalUYU));
      const freeMonthLabel = maxFinishOffset > 0 ? formatMonthKeyLabel(shiftMonthKey(baseMk, maxFinishOffset)) : '';
      return { buckets, maxVal, totalPendingPlans, freeMonthLabel };
    }

    // === GEMINI MULTIMODAL TICKET SCANNER (📷 / Ctrl+V) ===
    function compressImageToBase64(fileOrBlob) {
      return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
        const reader = new FileReader();
        reader.onerror = () => reject(new Error('No se pudo leer la imagen.'));
        reader.onload = () => {
          const dataUrl = String(reader.result || '');
          const img = new Image();
          img.onload = () => {
            try {
              const maxDim = 1280;
              let w = img.width, h = img.height;
              if (w > maxDim || h > maxDim) {
                const ratio = Math.min(maxDim / w, maxDim / h);
                w = Math.round(w * ratio);
                h = Math.round(h * ratio);
              }
              const canvas = document.createElement('canvas');
              canvas.width = w;
              canvas.height = h;
              const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
              ctx.drawImage(img, 0, 0, w, h);
              const outUrl = canvas.toDataURL('image/jpeg', 0.82);
              const base64 = outUrl.split(',')[1] || '';
              resolve({ base64, mimeType: 'image/jpeg' });
            } catch (err) {
              const rawB64 = dataUrl.split(',')[1] || '';
              resolve({ base64: rawB64, mimeType: fileOrBlob.type || 'image/jpeg' });
            }
          };
          img.onerror = () => {
            const rawB64 = dataUrl.split(',')[1] || '';
            resolve({ base64: rawB64, mimeType: fileOrBlob.type || 'image/jpeg' });
          };
          img.src = dataUrl;
        };
        reader.readAsDataURL(fileOrBlob);
      });
    }

    async function callGeminiJSONRaw(partsArray, cleanKey, maxTokens = 512) {
      const discovered = await discoverGeminiModelsForKey(cleanKey);
      const preferred = resolveBestGeminiModelFast();
      const orderedModels = [
        ...(discovered.includes(preferred) ? [preferred] : []),
        ...discovered.filter(m => m !== preferred)
      ];
      let lastError = null;
      for (const modelName of orderedModels) {
        const controller = ('AbortController' in window) ? new AbortController() : null;
        const timer = controller ? setTimeout(() => controller.abort(), 18000) : null;
        try {
          const endpoint = `https://generativelanguage.googleapis.com/v1beta/models/${modelName}:generateContent?key=${encodeURIComponent(cleanKey)}`;
          const res = await fetch(endpoint, {
            method: 'POST',
            headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
            signal: controller ? controller.signal : undefined,
            body: JSON.stringify({
              contents: [{ role: 'user', parts: partsArray }],
              generationConfig: {
                temperature: 0.1,
                maxOutputTokens: maxTokens,
                responseMimeType: 'application/json'
              }
            })
          });
          const data = await res.json().catch(() => ({}));
          if (!res.ok) {
            const apiErr = (data && data.error && data.error.message) ? data.error.message : `HTTP ${res.status}`;
            throw new Error(`${modelName}: ${apiErr}`);
          }
          const rawText = data?.candidates?.[0]?.content?.parts?.[0]?.text || '';
          if (!rawText.trim()) throw new Error(`${modelName}: respuesta vacía`);
          const cleaned = rawText.replace(/^```json\s*|\s*```$/gi, '').trim();
          const parsed = JSON.parse(cleaned);
          localStorage.setItem('KRONO_GEMINI_MODEL', modelName);
          return { parsed, modelName };
        } catch (err) {
          lastError = err;
        } finally {
          if (timer) clearTimeout(timer);
        }
      }
      throw lastError || new Error('No se pudo conectar con Gemini.');
    }

    // === FEATURE: DAYS TO CLOSING & BEST CARD TODAY ===
    function getCardDaysToNextClose(cardObj, now = new Date()) {
      if (!cardObj) return null;
      const closeDay = parseClosingDayNumber(cardObj.closingDay);
      if (!closeDay) return null;
      const todayStart = new Date(now.getFullYear(), now.getMonth(), now.getDate(), 0, 0, 0, 0);
      let nextClose = makeClampedMonthDate(now.getFullYear(), now.getMonth(), closeDay, false);
      if (nextClose.getTime() < todayStart.getTime()) {
        nextClose = makeClampedMonthDate(now.getFullYear(), now.getMonth() + 1, closeDay, false);
      }
      const diffDays = Math.round((nextClose.getTime() - todayStart.getTime()) / 86400000);
      return { days: Math.max(0, diffDays), nextCloseDate: nextClose };
    }

    function getCardDaysToNextDue(cardObj, now = new Date()) {
      if (!cardObj) return null;
      const dueDay = parseClosingDayNumber(cardObj.dueDay);
      if (!dueDay) return null;
      const todayStart = new Date(now.getFullYear(), now.getMonth(), now.getDate(), 0, 0, 0, 0);
      let nextDue = makeClampedMonthDate(now.getFullYear(), now.getMonth(), dueDay, false);
      if (nextDue.getTime() < todayStart.getTime()) {
        nextDue = makeClampedMonthDate(now.getFullYear(), now.getMonth() + 1, dueDay, false);
      }
      return Math.max(0, Math.round((nextDue.getTime() - todayStart.getTime()) / 86400000));
    }

    function getBestCardNameToday(now = new Date()) {
      const cards = Array.isArray(state.creditCards) ? state.creditCards : [];
      const scored = cards
        .map(c => ({ name: c.name, info: getCardDaysToNextClose(c, now) }))
        .filter(x => x.info !== null);
      if (scored.length < 2) return '';
      scored.sort((a, b) => b.info.days - a.info.days);
      return scored[0].info.days > scored[1].info.days ? String(scored[0].name || '').trim().toLowerCase() : '';
    }

    // === FEATURE: SMART PROACTIVE ALERTS ===
    function getSmartAlerts() {
      const alerts = [];
      const now = new Date();
      const curMk = getCurrentMonthKey();
      const rate = Number(state.exchangeRate) || 41.5;

      // 1. Cards closing or due within 0-5 days (only if pending > 0)
      const cardsBd = getDebtsCardsBreakdown();
      const savedCards = Array.isArray(state.creditCards) ? state.creditCards : [];
      cardsBd.forEach(c => {
        if (c.pendingItems <= 0) return;
        const meta = savedCards.find(sc => String(sc.name || '').trim().toLowerCase() === String(c.name || '').trim().toLowerCase());
        if (!meta) return;
        const closeInfo = getCardDaysToNextClose(meta, now);
        const dueDays = getCardDaysToNextDue(meta, now);
        const safeName = escapeAttr(c.name).replace(/'/g, "\\'");
        if (dueDays !== null && dueDays <= 5) {
          alerts.push({
            priority: dueDays <= 2 ? 1 : 2,
            tone: dueDays <= 2 ? 'rose' : 'amber',
            icon: '💳',
            text: `${c.name} vence ${dueDays === 0 ? 'hoy' : (dueDays === 1 ? 'mañana' : 'en ' + dueDays + ' días')} (${formatMoney(c.nextPaymentUYU, 'UYU')})`,
            actionLabel: 'Pagar',
            actionOnClick: `openPayCardClosingModal('${safeName}')`
          });
        } else if (closeInfo && closeInfo.days <= 4) {
          alerts.push({
            priority: 3,
            tone: 'amber',
            icon: '🗓️',
            text: `${c.name} cierra ${closeInfo.days === 0 ? 'hoy' : (closeInfo.days === 1 ? 'mañana' : 'en ' + closeInfo.days + ' días')} (${formatShortDayMonth(closeInfo.nextCloseDate)})`,
            actionLabel: 'Ver',
            actionOnClick: `openDebtsFilteredByCard('${safeName}')`
          });
        }
      });

      // 2. Unpaid recurring expenses due in <= 5 days or overdue this month
      const todayDay = now.getDate();
      (Array.isArray(state.recurringExpenses) ? state.recurringExpenses : []).forEach(rec => {
        const paidArr = Array.isArray(rec.paidMonths) ? rec.paidMonths : [];
        if (paidArr.includes(curMk)) return;
        const dDay = Math.max(1, Math.min(31, Number(rec.dayOfMonth) || 10));
        const diff = dDay - todayDay;
        if (diff <= 5) {
          alerts.push({
            priority: diff < 0 ? 1 : 2,
            tone: diff < 0 ? 'rose' : 'amber',
            icon: rec.icon || '🔁',
            text: `${rec.title} (${formatMoney(rec.amount, rec.currency || 'UYU')}) ${diff < 0 ? 'venció día ' + dDay : (diff === 0 ? 'vence hoy' : 'vence en ' + diff + 'd')}`,
            actionLabel: '✓ Pagar',
            actionOnClick: `payRecurringExpenseForMonth('${rec.id}', '${curMk}')`
          });
        }
      });

      // 3. Current month budgets >= 85%
      const curMonthTxs = getTransactionsForMonth(curMk);
      (Array.isArray(state.budgets) ? state.budgets : []).forEach(bg => {
        if (!bg.limit || bg.limit <= 0) return;
        const sp = curMonthTxs.filter(t => t.type === 'expense' && t.category === bg.name)
          .reduce((s, t) => s + (t.currency === 'USD' ? t.amount * rate : t.amount), 0);
        const pct = Math.round((sp / bg.limit) * 100);
        if (pct >= 85) {
          const safeCat = escapeAttr(bg.name).replace(/'/g, "\\'");
          alerts.push({
            priority: pct >= 100 ? 2 : 4,
            tone: pct >= 100 ? 'rose' : 'amber',
            icon: bg.icon || '🎯',
            text: `Presupuesto ${bg.name} al ${pct}% (${formatMoney(sp, 'UYU')} / ${formatMoney(bg.limit, 'UYU')})`,
            actionLabel: 'Ver',
            actionOnClick: `openCategoryInMovements('${safeCat}')`
          });
        }
      });

      alerts.sort((a, b) => a.priority - b.priority);
      return alerts.slice(0, 4);
    }

    function openPartialPayModal(debtId) {
      const d = (Array.isArray(state.debts) ? state.debts : []).find(x => x.id === debtId);
      if (!d || d.status === 'settled') return;

    function handlePartialPaySubmit(e) {
      if (e) e.preventDefault();
      const d = (Array.isArray(state.debts) ? state.debts : []).find(x => x.id === ui.partialPayDebtId);
      if (!d || d.status === 'settled') return;
      const remBefore = getDebtRemainingAmount(d);
      const rawAmt = Math.abs(parseFloat(document.getElementById('pp-amount').value) || 0);
      if (!rawAmt || rawAmt <= 0) return;
      const payAmt = Number(Math.min(remBefore, rawAmt).toFixed(2));
      const accId = document.getElementById('pp-account') ? document.getElementById('pp-account').value : (state.accounts[0] ? state.accounts[0].id : null);
      const noteTxt = document.getElementById('pp-note') ? (document.getElementById('pp-note').value || '').trim() : '';
      const isCredit = d.kind === 'credit';
      const instCount = Math.max(1, parseInt(d.installmentsCount, 10) || 1);
      const paidInst = Math.max(0, Math.min(instCount, parseInt(d.paidInstallments, 10) || 0));
      const newRem = Number(Math.max(0, remBefore - payAmt).toFixed(2));

      if (!Array.isArray(d.partialPayments)) d.partialPayments = [];
      d.partialPayments.unshift({
        amount: payAmt,
        currency: d.currency || 'UYU',
        note: noteTxt,
        timestamp: Date.now()
      });
      d.lastPaidAt = Date.now();
      d.updatedAt = Date.now();

      if (newRem <= 0.01) {
        d.paidInstallments = instCount;
        d.status = 'settled';
        d.settledAt = Date.now();
      } else if (instCount > 1) {
        const remInst = Math.max(1, instCount - paidInst);
        d.amount = Number(((newRem / remInst) * instCount).toFixed(2));
      } else {
        d.amount = newRem;
      }

      const acc = (state.accounts || []).find(a => a.id === accId) || (state.accounts && state.accounts[0]);
      ui.showPartialPayModal = false;
      ui.partialPayDebtId = null;

      addTransaction({
        title: `${isCredit ? 'Cobro parcial' : 'Abono parcial'}: ${d.title}${noteTxt ? ' (' + noteTxt + ')' : ''}`,
        amount: payAmt,
        currency: d.currency || 'UYU',
        type: isCredit ? 'income' : 'expense',
        category: isCredit ? 'Ingreso' : (d.paymentMethod === 'credit_card' ? 'Tarjeta / Crédito' : 'General'),
        accountId: acc ? acc.id : null,
        isDebtSettlement: true
      });
    }

    async function scanBulkStatementWithGemini(fileOrBlob) {
      const activeKey = (state.geminiApiKey && String(state.geminiApiKey).trim()) || (localStorage.getItem('KRONO_GEMINI_API_KEY') || '').trim();
      if (!activeKey) {
        ui.bulkImportStatus = '⚠️ Configurá tu Gemini API Key en ⚙️ Ajustes para importar desde capturas.';
        ui.bulkImportTone = 'err';
        render();
        return;
      }
      ui.bulkImportLoading = true;
      ui.bulkImportStatus = '🔍 Leyendo captura / estado de cuenta con Gemini...';
      ui.bulkImportTone = 'info';
      render();
      try {
        const { base64, mimeType } = await compressImageToBase64(fileOrBlob);
        if (!base64) throw new Error('Imagen vacía o no compatible.');
        const budgetNames = (state.budgets || []).map(b => b.name);
        const cardNames = (state.creditCards || []).map(c => c.name);
        const todayIso = toDateInputValue(Date.now());
        const promptText = [
          'Analizá esta captura de home banking, estado de cuenta de tarjeta o lista de movimientos (Uruguay/LATAM) y extraé TODOS los movimientos visibles en formato JSON válido:',
          '{"items":[{"title":"Comercio o concepto corto","amount":1234.5,"currency":"UYU|USD","type":"expense|income","category":"categoría válida","date":"YYYY-MM-DD","payMode":"cash|credit_card","cardName":"nombre tarjeta o vacío","installmentsCount":1}]}',
          'Reglas:',
          '- Extraé hasta 25 movimientos en orden. Ignorá líneas de "Saldo anterior", "Saldo total" o "Pago mínimo".',
          '- amount debe ser siempre positivo numérico (sin símbolos ni separadores de miles).',
          '- Si no se ve el año en una fecha, asumí el año actual (' + todayIso.slice(0, 4) + '). Si no se ve fecha, usá "' + todayIso + '".',
          '- Categorías válidas: ' + JSON.stringify([...budgetNames, 'General', 'Ingreso']),
          '- Tarjetas del usuario (si corresponde usá este nombre exacto): ' + JSON.stringify(cardNames),
          '- Si la captura es de resumen de tarjeta de crédito, poné payMode="credit_card". Si es cuenta bancaria/débito, poné payMode="cash".'
        ].join('\n');

        const { parsed, modelName } = await callGeminiJSONRaw(
          [{ text: promptText }, { inline_data: { mime_type: mimeType, data: base64 } }],
          activeKey,
          2048
        );
        const rawItems = Array.isArray(parsed && parsed.items) ? parsed.items : [];
        const cleanItems = rawItems
          .filter(it => it && Math.abs(Number(it.amount) || 0) > 0)
          .slice(0, 25)
          .map((it, idx) => ({
            uid: 'bi_' + Date.now() + '_' + idx,
            selected: true,
            title: String(it.title || 'Movimiento').trim(),
            amount: Math.abs(Number(it.amount) || 0),
            currency: it.currency === 'USD' ? 'USD' : 'UYU',
            type: it.type === 'income' ? 'income' : 'expense',
            category: String(it.category || (it.type === 'income' ? 'Ingreso' : 'General')).trim(),
            date: /^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$/.test(String(it.date || '')) ? String(it.date) : todayIso,
            payMode: it.payMode === 'credit_card' ? 'credit_card' : 'cash',
            cardName: String(it.cardName || '').trim(),
            installmentsCount: Math.max(1, Math.min(120, parseInt(it.installmentsCount, 10) || 1))
          }));

        ui.bulkImportLoading = false;
        if (!cleanItems.length) {
          ui.bulkImportStatus = `⚠️ Gemini (${modelName}) no encontró movimientos con monto en esta imagen.`;
          ui.bulkImportTone = 'err';
        } else {
          ui.bulkImportItems = cleanItems;
          ui.bulkImportStatus = `✅ ${cleanItems.length} movimientos detectados con ${modelName}. Tildá los que quieras importar.`;
          ui.bulkImportTone = 'ok';
          spawnFloatingBurst(`📄 ${cleanItems.length} movimientos leídos`, true);
        }
        render();
      } catch (err) {
        ui.bulkImportLoading = false;
        ui.bulkImportStatus = `❌ Error al analizar captura: ${err && err.message ? err.message : 'no se pudo leer la imagen'}`;
        ui.bulkImportTone = 'err';
        render();
      }
    }

    function pickBestAccountForCurrency(currency, preferSavings = false) {
      const accs = Array.isArray(state.accounts) ? state.accounts : [];
      if (!accs.length) return null;
      if (preferSavings) {
        const sav = accs.find(a => a.currency === currency && /ahorro|saving|usd|dolares|dólares/i.test(String(a.name || '')))
          || accs.find(a => /ahorro|saving/i.test(String(a.name || '')))
          || accs.find(a => a.currency === currency);
        if (sav) return sav;
      }
      return accs.find(a => a.currency === currency) || accs[0];
    }

    function pickOriginAccountForSavings(targetSavingsAcc) {
      const accs = Array.isArray(state.accounts) ? state.accounts : [];
      if (!accs.length) return null;
      const others = accs.filter(a => !targetSavingsAcc || a.id !== targetSavingsAcc.id);
      if (targetSavingsAcc && targetSavingsAcc.currency === 'USD') {
        return others.find(a => a.currency === 'UYU' && /brou|debito|débito|banco|cuenta/i.test(String(a.name || '')))
          || others.find(a => a.currency === 'UYU')
          || others[0]
          || targetSavingsAcc;
      }
      return others.find(a => /brou|debito|débito|banco|efectivo|billetera/i.test(String(a.name || '')))
        || others[0]
        || targetSavingsAcc;
    }

    function payNextDebtInstallment(id, recordTx = true) {
      const list = Array.isArray(state.debts) ? state.debts : [];
      const d = list.find(x => x.id === id); if (!d || d.status === 'settled') return;
      const instCount = Math.max(1, parseInt(d.installmentsCount, 10) || 1);
      const paidInst = Math.max(0, parseInt(d.paidInstallments, 10) || 0);
      const instVal = getDebtInstallmentValue(d);
      const remBefore = getDebtRemainingAmount(d);
      const payVal = Math.min(remBefore, instVal || remBefore);
      const nextPaid = Math.min(instCount, paidInst + 1);
      const isCredit = d.kind === 'credit';
      const actionVerb = isCredit ? 'cobrar' : 'pagar';
      const linkedAcc = pickBestAccountForCurrency(d.currency, false);
      const accName = linkedAcc ? linkedAcc.name : 'cuenta principal';
      const flowNote = recordTx
        ? (isCredit
            ? ` se sumará a "${escapeAttr(accName)}"`
            : ` saldrá de "${escapeAttr(accName)}"`)
        : ' sin asentar en cuenta';

      openConfirmModal({
        title: `💳 Confirmar ${isCredit ? 'Cobro' : 'Pago'} de Cuota #${nextPaid}/${instCount}`,
        message: `¿Querés ${actionVerb} la cuota #${nextPaid} de "${escapeAttr(d.title)}" por ${formatMoney(payVal, d.currency)} y que${flowNote}?`,
        confirmText: recordTx ? `Confirmar y Asentar` : `Marcar Cuota Pagada`,
        danger: false,
        onConfirm: () => {
          d.paidInstallments = nextPaid;
          d.lastPaidAt = Date.now();
          if (nextPaid >= instCount || getDebtRemainingAmount(d) <= 0.01) {
            d.status = 'settled';
            d.settledAt = Date.now();
          } else {
            updateDebtDueDateForNextCycle(d);
          }
          if (recordTx && payVal > 0) {
            const cardTag = d.cardName ? ` [${d.cardName}]` : '';
            const cuotaTag = instCount > 1 ? ` (Cuota ${nextPaid}/${instCount})` : '';
            addTransaction({
              title: `${isCredit ? 'Cobro' : 'Pago'}: ${d.title}${cuotaTag}${cardTag}`,
              amount: payVal,
              currency: d.currency,
              type: isCredit ? 'income' : 'expense',
              category: isCredit ? 'Ingreso' : (d.paymentMethod === 'credit_card' ? 'Tarjeta de Crédito' : 'General'),
              accountId: linkedAcc ? linkedAcc.id : null,
              isDebtSettlement: true
            });
            spawnFloatingBurst(`✅ ${instCount > 1 ? 'Cuota ' + nextPaid + '/' + instCount + ' asentada' : 'Liquidado y asentado'}`, isCredit);
            return;
          }
          spawnFloatingBurst(nextPaid >= instCount ? '✅ Todas las cuotas saldadas' : `✅ Cuota ${nextPaid}/${instCount} marcada`, true);
          saveState(true, true);
        }
      });
    }

    async function discoverGeminiModelsForKey(cleanKey) {
      const cachedListRaw = sessionStorage.getItem('KRONO_DISCOVERED_GEMINI_MODELS');
      if (cachedListRaw) {
        try {
          const parsed = JSON.parse(cachedListRaw);
          if (Array.isArray(parsed) && parsed.length) return parsed;
        } catch (e) {}
      }
      try {
        const res = await fetch(`https://generativelanguage.googleapis.com/v1beta/models?key=${encodeURIComponent(cleanKey)}`, { cache: 'no-store' });
        if (!res.ok) return GEMINI_MODEL_PRIORITY.slice();
        const data = await res.json();
        const available = (data.models || [])
          .filter(m => Array.isArray(m.supportedGenerationMethods) && m.supportedGenerationMethods.includes('generateContent'))
          .map(m => String(m.name || '').replace(/^models\//, ''))
          .filter(name => name && name.includes('gemini') && !/embedding|imagen|veo|tts|audio|robotics|computer-use|deep-research|thinking/i.test(name));

        if (!available.length) return GEMINI_MODEL_PRIORITY.slice();

        const ordered = [];
        for (const pref of GEMINI_MODEL_PRIORITY) {
          if (available.includes(pref) && !ordered.includes(pref)) ordered.push(pref);
        }
        for (const name of available) {
          if (/flash/i.test(name) && !/3\.8/i.test(name) && !ordered.includes(name)) ordered.push(name);
        }
        for (const name of available) {
          if (!ordered.includes(name)) ordered.push(name);
        }
        sessionStorage.setItem('KRONO_DISCOVERED_GEMINI_MODELS', JSON.stringify(ordered));
        return ordered;
      } catch (e) {
        return GEMINI_MODEL_PRIORITY.slice();
      }
    }

      const cached = (localStorage.getItem('KRONO_GEMINI_MODEL') || '').trim();

      return GEMINI_MODEL_PRIORITY[0];

    async function callSingleGeminiModel(modelName, compactPrompt, cleanKey) {
      const controller = ('AbortController' in window) ? new AbortController() : null;
      const timer = controller ? setTimeout(() => controller.abort(), 14000) : null;
      try {
        const endpoint = `https://generativelanguage.googleapis.com/v1beta/models/${modelName}:generateContent?key=${encodeURIComponent(cleanKey)}`;
        const res = await fetch(endpoint, {
          method: 'POST',
          headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
          signal: controller ? controller.signal : undefined,
          body: JSON.stringify({
            contents: [{ role: 'user', parts: [{ text: compactPrompt }] }],
            generationConfig: {
              temperature: 0,
              maxOutputTokens: 512,
              responseMimeType: 'application/json'
            }
          })
        });
        const data = await res.json().catch(() => ({}));
        if (!res.ok) {
          const apiErr = (data && data.error && data.error.message) ? data.error.message : `HTTP ${res.status}`;
          const err = new Error(`${modelName}: ${apiErr}`);
          err.status = res.status;
          throw err;
        }
        const rawText = data?.candidates?.[0]?.content?.parts?.[0]?.text || '';
        if (!rawText.trim()) {
          throw new Error(`${modelName}: respuesta vacía`);
        }
        const cleanedJson = rawText.replace(/^```json\s*|\s*```$/gi, '').trim();
        const parsed = JSON.parse(cleanedJson);
        if (!Array.isArray(parsed.actions)) {
          throw new Error(`${modelName}: JSON sin actions`);
        }
        return parsed.actions;
      } finally {
        if (timer) clearTimeout(timer);
      }
    }

      const orderedModels = [

        ...discovered.filter(m => m !== preferred)

      let lastError = null;
      for (let attempt = 0; attempt < 2; attempt++) {
        for (const modelName of orderedModels) {
          try {

          if (!cNorm) return true;
          const label = normalizeStr(`${getDebtInstrumentLabel(d)} ${d.title || ''} ${d.counterparty || ''} ${d.paymentMethod || ''}`);
          if (/\b(tarjeta|visa|master|oca|amex|cabal|credito|crédito)\b/.test(cNorm) && !/\b(prestamo|préstamo|persona)\b/.test(cNorm)) {
            const isCardItem = d.paymentMethod === 'credit_card' || Boolean((d.cardName || '').trim()) || /tarjeta|visa|master|oca|amex|cabal|zodimac/i.test(label);
            if (!isCardItem) return false;
          }
          if (/\b(prestamo|préstamo)\b/.test(cNorm)) {
            const isLoanItem = d.paymentMethod === 'personal' || /prestamo|préstamo/i.test(label);
            if (!isLoanItem) return false;
          }
          return label.includes(cNorm) || cNorm.includes(label) || /\b(tarjeta|prestamo|préstamo|cuota|cuotas|deuda)\b/.test(cNorm);
        });
      }

      for (const act of actions) {
        if (!act || !act.op) continue;

        if (act.op === 'pay_obligations') {
          const rawScope = act.scope || 'current_installments';
          const explicitlyAskedFull = /\b(?:todo|toda|todas|saldo\s+total|totalidad|completo|completa|cancele\s+todo|liquide\s+todo)\b/i.test(normalizeStr(originalText || ''));
          const scope = (rawScope === 'full_balance' && !explicitlyAskedFull) ? 'current_installments' : rawScope;
          const sourceAcc = matchAccount(act.accountQuery, act.currency || null);
          const targets = matchOpenDebts(act.cardQuery);
          if (!targets.length) continue;

          let totalPaidUYU = 0;
          let itemsTouched = 0;

          if (scope === 'current_installments') {
            for (const d of targets) {
              const remItem = getDebtRemainingAmount(d);
              if (remItem <= 0.01) continue;
              const instCount = Math.max(1, parseInt(d.installmentsCount, 10) || 1);
              const paidInst = Math.max(0, Math.min(instCount, parseInt(d.paidInstallments, 10) || 0));
              const instVal = getDebtInstallmentValue(d);
              const payNow = instCount > 1 ? Math.min(remItem, instVal) : remItem;
              const nextPaid = Math.min(instCount, paidInst + 1);
              d.paidInstallments = nextPaid;
              d.lastPaidAt = Date.now();
              if (nextPaid >= instCount || getDebtRemainingAmount(d) <= 0.01) {
                d.status = 'settled';
                d.settledAt = Date.now();
              } else {
                updateDebtDueDateForNextCycle(d);
              }
              totalPaidUYU += (d.currency === 'USD' ? payNow * rate : payNow);
              itemsTouched++;
            }
          } else if (scope === 'full_balance') {
            for (const d of targets) {
              const remItem = getDebtRemainingAmount(d);
              if (remItem <= 0.01) continue;
              const instCount = Math.max(1, parseInt(d.installmentsCount, 10) || 1);
              d.paidInstallments = instCount;
              d.lastPaidAt = Date.now();
              d.status = 'settled';
              d.settledAt = Date.now();
              totalPaidUYU += (d.currency === 'USD' ? remItem * rate : remItem);
              itemsTouched++;
            }
          } else if (scope === 'exact_amount') {
            const amt = Math.abs(Number(act.amount) || 0);
            const cur = act.currency || (sourceAcc ? sourceAcc.currency : 'UYU');
            let remPoolUYU = (cur === 'USD' ? amt * rate : amt);
            for (const d of targets) {
              if (remPoolUYU <= 0.01) break;
              const remItem = getDebtRemainingAmount(d);
              const remItemUYU = (d.currency === 'USD' ? remItem * rate : remItem);
              const instCount = Math.max(1, parseInt(d.installmentsCount, 10) || 1);
              const paidInst = Math.max(0, Math.min(instCount, parseInt(d.paidInstallments, 10) || 0));
              const instVal = getDebtInstallmentValue(d);
              const instValUYU = (d.currency === 'USD' ? instVal * rate : instVal);
              if (remPoolUYU >= remItemUYU - 0.01) {
                d.paidInstallments = instCount;
                d.lastPaidAt = Date.now();
                d.status = 'settled';
                d.settledAt = Date.now();
                remPoolUYU -= remItemUYU;
                totalPaidUYU += remItemUYU;
                itemsTouched++;
              } else if (instCount > 1 && remPoolUYU >= instValUYU * 0.5) {
                const covered = Math.max(1, Math.min(instCount - paidInst, Math.floor((remPoolUYU + 0.01) / Math.max(0.01, instValUYU))));
                const nextPaid = Math.min(instCount, paidInst + covered);
                const appliedVal = Number((instVal * covered).toFixed(2));
                d.paidInstallments = nextPaid;
                d.lastPaidAt = Date.now();
                if (nextPaid >= instCount) {
                  d.status = 'settled';
                  d.settledAt = Date.now();
                } else {
                  updateDebtDueDateForNextCycle(d);
                }
                const appliedUYU = (d.currency === 'USD' ? appliedVal * rate : appliedVal);
                remPoolUYU = Math.max(0, remPoolUYU - appliedUYU);
                totalPaidUYU += appliedUYU;
                itemsTouched++;
              } else {
                const paidUYU = Math.min(remItemUYU, remPoolUYU);
                const paidCur = (d.currency === 'USD' ? paidUYU / rate : paidUYU);
                const newRemCur = Math.max(0, remItem - paidCur);
                if (newRemCur <= 0.01) {
                  d.amount = 0;
                  d.paidInstallments = instCount;
                  d.status = 'settled';
                  d.settledAt = Date.now();
                } else if (instCount > 1) {
                  const left = Math.max(1, instCount - paidInst);
                  const newInst = Number((newRemCur / left).toFixed(2));
                  d.amount = Number((newInst * instCount).toFixed(2));
                } else {
                  d.amount = Number(newRemCur.toFixed(2));
                }
                remPoolUYU = 0;
                totalPaidUYU += paidUYU;
                itemsTouched++;
              }
            }
          }

          if (itemsTouched > 0 && totalPaidUYU > 0) {
            const txCur = act.currency || (sourceAcc ? sourceAcc.currency : 'UYU');
            const txAmt = txCur === 'USD' ? Number((totalPaidUYU / rate).toFixed(2)) : Math.round(totalPaidUYU);
            const deductInAcc = (sourceAcc && sourceAcc.currency === 'USD')
              ? Number((totalPaidUYU / rate).toFixed(2))
              : Math.round(totalPaidUYU);
            if (sourceAcc) {
              sourceAcc.balance = Number((sourceAcc.balance - deductInAcc).toFixed(2));
            }
            const now = new Date();
            const labelScope = scope === 'current_installments' ? 'Cuotas del mes' : (scope === 'full_balance' ? 'Saldo total' : 'Pago');
            const tx = {
              id: 'tx_' + Date.now() + '_' + Math.floor(Math.random() * 1000),
              title: (fromExternal ? '🤖 ' : '') + `${labelScope}${act.cardQuery ? ' (' + act.cardQuery + ')' : ''} con ${sourceAcc ? sourceAcc.name : 'Efectivo'}`,
              amount: txAmt,
              currency: txCur,
              type: 'expense',
              category: 'Tarjeta / Crédito',
              accountId: sourceAcc ? sourceAcc.id : 'acc_cash',
              accountName: sourceAcc ? sourceAcc.name : 'Efectivo',
              date: `${String(now.getDate()).padStart(2,'0')}/${String(now.getMonth()+1).padStart(2,'0')} ${String(now.getHours()).padStart(2,'0')}:${String(now.getMinutes()).padStart(2,'0')}`,
              timestamp: Date.now(),
              isDebtSettlement: true
            };
            state.transactions.unshift(tx);
            spawnFloatingBurst(`-${formatMoney(txAmt, txCur)} (${sourceAcc ? sourceAcc.name.split(' ')[0] : ''})`, false);
            summaryParts.push(`${labelScope}: -${formatMoney(txAmt, txCur)} en ${itemsTouched} ítem(s) desde ${sourceAcc ? sourceAcc.name : 'Efectivo'}`);
            executedAny = true;
          }
        } else if (act.op === 'add_transaction') {
          const amt = Math.abs(Number(act.amount) || 0);
          if (amt > 0) {
            const reqCur = act.currency || state.defaultCurrency || 'UYU';
            const acc = matchAccount(act.accountQuery, reqCur);
            const isSavAct = /\b(ahorr[eo]|ahorrar|ahorro|reservar|reserve)\b/i.test(normalizeStr(`${act.title || ''} ${act.category || ''} ${originalText || ''}`));
            const finalTitle = isSavAct ? (`Ahorro: ${(act.title || 'Reserva').replace(/^ahorro:?\s*/i, '')}`) : (act.title || 'Movimiento al contado');
            const tx = addTransaction({
              title: finalTitle,
              amount: amt,
              currency: reqCur,
              type: act.type === 'income' ? 'income' : 'expense',
              category: act.category || (act.type === 'income' ? 'Ingreso' : 'Comida y Súper'),
              accountId: acc ? acc.id : null,
              fromExternal
            });
            if (tx) {
              summaryParts.push(`${tx.title} (${formatMoney(tx.amount, tx.currency)} en ${tx.accountName})`);
              executedAny = true;
            }
          }
        } else if (act.op === 'add_debt') {
          const rawAmt = Math.abs(Number(act.amount) || 0);
          const instC = Math.max(1, parseInt(act.installmentsCount, 10) || 1);
          if (rawAmt > 0) {
            const totalAmt = (instC > 1 && act.perInstallment) ? Number((rawAmt * instC).toFixed(2)) : rawAmt;
            const normOrig = normalizeStr(originalText || '');
            const isPurchaseOnCredit = /\b(?:gaste|compre|pague|en\s+credito|a\s+credito|tarjeta\s+de\s+credito)\b/i.test(normOrig) && !/\b(?:me\s+deben|me\s+debe|preste|por\s+cobrar)\b/i.test(normOrig);
            const kind = isPurchaseOnCredit ? 'debt' : (act.kind === 'credit' ? 'credit' : 'debt');
            const payMethod = isPurchaseOnCredit ? 'credit_card' : (act.paymentMethod === 'personal' ? 'personal' : 'credit_card');
            const cardName = payMethod === 'credit_card' ? ((act.cardName || act.counterparty || 'Tarjeta de Crédito').trim()) : '';
            const partyName = payMethod === 'personal' ? ((act.counterparty || act.cardName || 'Préstamo').trim()) : (cardName || 'Tarjeta');
            const cur = act.currency || state.defaultCurrency || 'UYU';

            if (cardName && Array.isArray(state.creditCards)) {
              const exists = state.creditCards.some(c => String(c.name || '').trim().toLowerCase() === cardName.toLowerCase());
              if (!exists) {
                state.creditCards.unshift({
                  id: 'card_' + Date.now() + '_' + Math.floor(Math.random() * 1000),
                  name: cardName,
                  bank: '',
                  brand: 'Visa',
                  currency: cur,
                  closingDay: '',
                  dueDay: ''
                });
              }
            }

            state.debts.unshift({
              id: 'debt_' + Date.now() + '_' + Math.floor(Math.random() * 1000),
              title: act.title || (payMethod === 'personal' ? 'Préstamo' : 'Compra tarjeta'),
              counterparty: partyName,
              paymentMethod: payMethod,
              cardName,
              installmentsCount: instC,
              paidInstallments: 0,
              amount: totalAmt,
              currency: cur,
              kind,
              dueDate: act.dueDate || '',
              status: 'pending',
              notes: '',
              createdAt: Date.now()
            });

            const now = new Date();
            const cuotaTag = instC > 1 ? ` • ${instC} cuotas` : '';
            const tx = {
              id: 'tx_ai_' + Date.now() + '_' + Math.floor(Math.random() * 1000),
              title: (fromExternal ? '🤖 ' : '') + (payMethod === 'personal' ? `🤝 Préstamo: ${act.title || 'Préstamo'} (${partyName}${cuotaTag})` : `💳 ${act.title || 'Compra'} (${cardName}${cuotaTag})`),
              amount: totalAmt,
              currency: cur,
              type: kind === 'credit' ? 'income' : 'expense',
              category: payMethod === 'personal' ? 'Préstamo' : 'Tarjeta / Crédito',
              accountId: payMethod === 'personal' ? 'loan_ledger' : ('card_' + cardName.toLowerCase().replace(/[^a-z0-9]+/g, '_')),
              accountName: payMethod === 'personal' ? `Préstamo (${partyName})` : cardName,
              date: `${String(now.getDate()).padStart(2,'0')}/${String(now.getMonth()+1).padStart(2,'0')} ${String(now.getHours()).padStart(2,'0')}:${String(now.getMinutes()).padStart(2,'0')}`,
              timestamp: Date.now()
            };
            state.transactions.unshift(tx);
            spawnFloatingBurst(`${payMethod === 'personal' ? '🤝' : '💳'} ${formatMoney(totalAmt, cur)}`, kind === 'credit');
            summaryParts.push(`${payMethod === 'personal' ? 'Préstamo' : 'Tarjeta'}: ${act.title || ''} (${formatMoney(totalAmt, cur)}${cuotaTag})`);
            executedAny = true;
          }
        } else if (act.op === 'query_balance') {
          const acc = act.accountQuery ? matchAccount(act.accountQuery) : null;
          const reply = acc ? `El saldo de ${acc.name} es de ${formatMoney(acc.balance, acc.currency)}.` : `Tu patrimonio total es de ${formatMoney(getTotals().totalUYU, 'UYU')}.`;
          ui.geminiResponse = { mode: 'query', prompt: originalText, reply, items: [] };
          speakText(reply);
          render();
          return true;
        }
      }

      if (executedAny) {
        const reply = (fromExternal ? '[Google Tasks] ' : '') + summaryParts.join(' • ');
        ui.geminiResponse = { mode: 'action', prompt: originalText, reply, items: [] };
        speakText(reply);
        saveState(true, true);
        return true;
      }
      return false;
    }

    async function processGeminiCommand(rawInput, fromExternal = false) {
      if (!rawInput || !rawInput.trim()) return;
      const text = rawInput.replace(/_/g, ' ').replace(/\+/g, ' ').trim().replace(/^(?:hey\s+gemini|hola\s+gemini|gemini|tarea\s+|en\s+krono\s+|krono[:\s,-]*)+/i, '').trim();
      const activeKey = (state.geminiApiKey && String(state.geminiApiKey).trim()) || (localStorage.getItem('KRONO_GEMINI_API_KEY') || '').trim();
      if (activeKey && !state.geminiApiKey) state.geminiApiKey = activeKey;

      if (!activeKey) {
        ui.lastInterpreterMode = '⚠️ Falta Gemini API Key';
        ui.geminiResponse = {
          mode: 'error',
          prompt: text,
          reply: '⚠️ Configurá tu Gemini API Key en ⚙️ Ajustes para usar 100% IA Gemini (el respaldo local está desactivado).',
          items: []
        };
        render();
        return;
      }

      ui.lastInterpreterMode = '🧠 IA Gemini (procesando...)';
      render();
      try {
        const { actions, modelName } = await interpretWithGeminiAI(text, activeKey);
        if (actions && actions.length && executeStructuredActions(actions, text, fromExternal)) {
          ui.lastInterpreterMode = `🧠 100% IA Gemini (${modelName})`;
          if (ui.geminiResponse) {
            ui.geminiResponse.reply = `[🧠 ${modelName}] ` + ui.geminiResponse.reply;
            render();
          }
          return;
        }
        ui.lastInterpreterMode = `🧠 IA Gemini (${modelName} • sin acción)`;
        ui.geminiResponse = {
          mode: 'error',
          prompt: text,
          reply: `🧠 Gemini (${modelName}) no detectó una acción financiera en esa frase. Probá indicando monto y concepto.`,
          items: []
        };
        render();
      } catch (err) {
        const reason = (err && err.message) ? err.message : 'error de conexión con la API de Gemini';
        ui.lastInterpreterMode = '❌ Error IA Gemini';
        ui.geminiResponse = {
          mode: 'error',
          prompt: text,
          reply: `❌ Error de IA Gemini: ${reason}`,
          items: []
        };
        render();
      }
    }

    function runLocalRuleInterpreter(text, lower, fromExternal = false) {
      if ((lower.includes('actualiza') || lower.includes('release')) && lower.includes('app')) {
        ui.showOtaModal = true;
        checkGitHubReleaseOtaUpdate(true);
        render();
        return;
      }

      if (lower.includes('cuanto') || lower.includes('saldo') || lower.includes('patrimonio')) {
        const sp = findAccountMentionInText(text);
        const reply = sp ? `El saldo de ${sp.name} es de ${formatMoney(sp.balance, sp.currency)}.` : `Tu patrimonio total es de ${formatMoney(getTotals().totalUYU, 'UYU')}.`;
        ui.geminiResponse = { mode: 'query', prompt: text, reply, items: [] };
        speakText(reply);
        render();
        return;
      }

      function isCardOrDebtItem(item) {
        if (!item || item.status === 'settled') return false;
        const label = `${getDebtInstrumentLabel(item)} ${item.title || ''} ${item.counterparty || ''}`;
        return item.paymentMethod === 'credit_card' || Boolean((item.cardName || '').trim()) || /tarjeta|visa|master|oca|amex|cabal|zodimac|brou|itau|itaú|santander|bbva|scotia|prex|midinero|cuota|prestamo|préstamo|deuda/i.test(normalizeStr(label));
      }

      function findMatchingCardName(normText) {
        const cards = Array.isArray(state.creditCards) ? state.creditCards : [];
        for (const c of cards) {
          const cNorm = normalizeStr(c.name || '');
          if (cNorm && normText.includes(cNorm)) return c.name;
          const bNorm = normalizeStr(c.bank || '');
          if (bNorm && bNorm.length >= 3 && normText.includes(bNorm)) return c.name;
        }
        const m = normText.match(/\b(?:(?:itau|itaú|brou|santander|bbva|scotia|hsbc|prex|midinero|zodimac)\s+(?:visa|mastercard|master|oca|amex|cabal|recompensa)|visa|mastercard|master|oca|american\s+express|amex|cabal|brou\s+recompensa|santander|itau|itaú|bbva|scotia|hsbc|prex|midinero|zodimac)\b/i);
        return m ? m[0].replace(/\b\w/g, ch => ch.toUpperCase()) : '';
      }

      function resolvePaymentSourceAccount(normText) {
        if (/\b(efectivo|billetera|cash|contado|en mano|monedero|plata en efectivo)\b/i.test(normText)) {
          return state.accounts.find(a => a.id === 'acc_cash' || /efectivo|billetera|cash|mano/i.test(normalizeStr(a.name))) || state.accounts[0];
        }
        const mentioned = findAccountMentionInText(normText);
        if (mentioned) return mentioned;
        return state.accounts.find(a => a.id === 'acc_cash' || /efectivo|billetera|cash/i.test(normalizeStr(a.name))) || state.accounts[0];
      }

      const isPayingCardOrDebt = /\b(?:pague|pagar|abone|abonar|cancele|cancelar|liquide|liquidar|salde|saldar)\b/i.test(lower)
        && /\b(?:tarjeta|visa|mastercard|master|oca|amex|cabal|zodimac|cierre|resumen|deuda|cuota|cuotas|prestamo|préstamo|credito|crédito|pendiente)\b/i.test(lower);

      if (isPayingCardOrDebt) {
        if (!Array.isArray(state.debts)) state.debts = [];
        const rate = Number(state.exchangeRate) || 41.5;
        const explicitAmount = extractSmartAmount(lower);
        const targetCardName = findMatchingCardName(lower);
        const sourceAcc = resolvePaymentSourceAccount(lower);
        const targetCurrency = detectCurrencyInText(lower) || (sourceAcc ? sourceAcc.currency : (state.defaultCurrency || 'UYU'));

        // Distinguish whether user asked for THIS MONTH'S installments ("cuotas de este mes" / "cuotas del mes" / "cuota de este mes" / "cuotas") vs FULL BALANCE ("todo" / "saldo total")
        const wantsCurrentInstallmentsOnly = !/\b(?:todo|toda|todas|saldo\s+total|totalidad|completo|completa|cancele\s+todo|liquide\s+todo)\b/i.test(lower);

        let candidateDebts = state.debts.filter(d => {
          if (d.status === 'settled' || d.kind === 'credit') return false;
          if (targetCardName) {
            const dLabel = normalizeStr(getDebtInstrumentLabel(d) || `${d.title || ''} ${d.counterparty || ''}`);
            return dLabel.includes(normalizeStr(targetCardName)) || normalizeStr(targetCardName).includes(dLabel);
          }
          return isCardOrDebtItem(d);
        });

        if (!candidateDebts.length && !explicitAmount) {
          candidateDebts = state.debts.filter(d => d.status !== 'settled' && d.kind !== 'credit');
        }

        let calcUYU = 0;
        if (explicitAmount > 0) {
          calcUYU = (targetCurrency === 'USD' ? explicitAmount * rate : explicitAmount);
        } else if (wantsCurrentInstallmentsOnly) {
          candidateDebts.forEach(d => {
            const rem = getDebtRemainingAmount(d);
            if (rem <= 0.01) return;
            const instCount = Math.max(1, parseInt(d.installmentsCount, 10) || 1);
            const instVal = getDebtInstallmentValue(d);
            const payNow = instCount > 1 ? Math.min(rem, instVal) : rem;
            calcUYU += (d.currency === 'USD' ? payNow * rate : payNow);
          });
        } else {
          candidateDebts.forEach(d => {
            const rem = getDebtRemainingAmount(d);
            calcUYU += (d.currency === 'USD' ? rem * rate : rem);
          });
        }

        const payAmountTargetCur = explicitAmount > 0
          ? explicitAmount
          : (targetCurrency === 'USD' ? Number((calcUYU / rate).toFixed(2)) : Math.round(calcUYU));

        if (payAmountTargetCur > 0) {
          let deductInAccCur = payAmountTargetCur;
          if (sourceAcc && sourceAcc.currency !== targetCurrency) {
            deductInAccCur = (targetCurrency === 'USD' && sourceAcc.currency === 'UYU')
              ? payAmountTargetCur * rate
              : payAmountTargetCur / rate;
          }

          let remainingCreditToApplyUYU = (targetCurrency === 'USD' ? payAmountTargetCur * rate : payAmountTargetCur);
          let settledCount = 0;
          let updatedInstallmentsCount = 0;

          for (const d of candidateDebts) {
            if (remainingCreditToApplyUYU <= 0.01) break;
            const remItem = getDebtRemainingAmount(d);
            if (remItem <= 0.01) continue;
            const remItemUYU = (d.currency === 'USD' ? remItem * rate : remItem);
            const instCount = Math.max(1, parseInt(d.installmentsCount, 10) || 1);
            const paidInst = Math.max(0, Math.min(instCount, parseInt(d.paidInstallments, 10) || 0));
            const instVal = getDebtInstallmentValue(d);
            const instValUYU = (d.currency === 'USD' ? instVal * rate : instVal);

            if (wantsCurrentInstallmentsOnly && !explicitAmount) {
              // Advance ONLY 1 installment (current month) per debt/card plan, keeping future installments pending
              const payNow = instCount > 1 ? Math.min(remItem, instVal) : remItem;
              const nextPaid = Math.min(instCount, paidInst + 1);
              d.paidInstallments = nextPaid;
              d.lastPaidAt = Date.now();
              if (nextPaid >= instCount || getDebtRemainingAmount(d) <= 0.01) {
                d.status = 'settled';
                d.settledAt = Date.now();
                settledCount++;
              } else {
                updateDebtDueDateForNextCycle(d);
                updatedInstallmentsCount++;
              }
              remainingCreditToApplyUYU = Math.max(0, remainingCreditToApplyUYU - (d.currency === 'USD' ? payNow * rate : payNow));
            } else if (remainingCreditToApplyUYU >= remItemUYU - 0.01 || (!explicitAmount && instCount === 1)) {
              d.paidInstallments = instCount;
              d.lastPaidAt = Date.now();
              d.status = 'settled';
              d.settledAt = Date.now();
              remainingCreditToApplyUYU = Math.max(0, remainingCreditToApplyUYU - remItemUYU);
              settledCount++;
            } else if (instCount > 1 && remainingCreditToApplyUYU >= instValUYU * 0.5) {
              const coveredInst = Math.max(1, Math.min(instCount - paidInst, Math.floor((remainingCreditToApplyUYU + 0.01) / Math.max(0.01, instValUYU))));
              const newPaid = Math.min(instCount, paidInst + coveredInst);
              const appliedVal = Number((instVal * coveredInst).toFixed(2));
              d.paidInstallments = newPaid;
              d.lastPaidAt = Date.now();
              if (newPaid >= instCount) {
                d.status = 'settled';
                d.settledAt = Date.now();
                settledCount++;
              } else {
                updateDebtDueDateForNextCycle(d);
                updatedInstallmentsCount++;
              }
              remainingCreditToApplyUYU = Math.max(0, remainingCreditToApplyUYU - (d.currency === 'USD' ? appliedVal * rate : appliedVal));
            } else if (explicitAmount > 0) {
              const paidUYU = Math.min(remItemUYU, remainingCreditToApplyUYU);
              const paidInDebtCur = (d.currency === 'USD' ? paidUYU / rate : paidUYU);
              const newRemInDebtCur = Math.max(0, remItem - paidInDebtCur);
